tatra saṃsthāpayetpṛthvīṃ paṃcagavyena pārthiva..
yathoktamaṃtraistalliṃgaistataḥ śuddhodakena tu..16..
5.267.d:
तत्र संस्थापयेत्पृथ्वीं पंचगव्येन पार्थिव..
यथोक्तमंत्रैस्तल्लिंगैस्ततः शुद्धोदकेन तु..16..
5.267.m:
There one should set down the earth with the five products of the cow, O king,
accompanied by the prescribed mantras matching the marks, and then with pure water,

5.267.s:
imaṃ me gaṃge yamune paṃcanadyastripuṣkaram..
śrīsūktaṃ pāvamānaṃ ca haimīṃ ca tadanaṃtaram..17..
5.267.d:
इमं मे गंगे यमुने पंचनद्यस्त्रिपुष्करम्..
श्रीसूक्तं पावमानं च हैमीं च तदनंतरम्..17..
5.267.m:
[reciting] 'imaṃ me gaṅge yamune,' the 'pañca nadyaḥ,' the 'tripuṣkaram,'
the Śrīsūkta, and the Pāvamāna hymn; and then the golden [earth] [one should bathe],

5.267.s: snānakarmaṇi yogyāṃśa svādiṣṭhāyanamuttamam..18..
5.267.d: स्नानकर्मणि योग्यांश स्वादिष्ठायनमुत्तमम्..18..
5.267.m: with portions suitable for the rite of bathing, [and with] the supreme 'svādiṣṭhayā' [hymn].

5.267.s:
evaṃ saṃsnāpya vidhivadvāsāṃsi paridhāpayet..
yuvā suvāsā maṃtreṇa sūkṣmāṇi vividhāni ca..19..
5.267.d:
एवं संस्नाप्य विधिवद्वासांसि परिधापयेत्..
युवा सुवासा मंत्रेण सूक्ष्माणि विविधानि च..19..
5.267.m:
Having thus bathed it according to rule, one should clothe it in garments,
fine and diverse, with the mantra 'yuvā suvāsāḥ'.

5.267.s:
ye bhūtānāmadhītyevaṃ tataḥ procya prapūjayet..
dhūrasīti ca maṃtreṇa dhūpaṃ dadyātsamāhitaḥ..6.268.20..
5.267.d:
ये भूतानामधीत्येवं ततः प्रोच्य प्रपूजयेत्..
धूरसीति च मंत्रेण धूपं दद्यात्समाहितः..6.268.20..
5.267.m:
Having thus recited 'ye bhūtānām,' one should then worship it.
With concentrated mind, one should offer incense with the mantra 'dhūr asi'.

5.267.s:
agnirjyotīti maṃtreṇa kuryādārārtikaṃ tataḥ..
ahamasmīti maṃtreṇa saptadhānyaṃ prakalpayet..21..
5.267.d:
अग्निर्ज्योतीति मंत्रेण कुर्यादारार्तिकं ततः..
अहमस्मीति मंत्रेण सप्तधान्यं प्रकल्पयेत्..21..
5.267.m:
Then one should perform the waving of lights with the mantra 'agnir jyotiḥ'.
With the mantra 'aham asmi,' one should arrange the seven grains.

5.267.s:
evaṃ kṛtvā'khilaṃ tasyā yajamānaḥ sitāṃbaraḥ..
puraḥ sthitoṃjaliṃ baddhvā maṃtrānetānudāharet..22..
5.267.d:
एवं कृत्वाऽखिलं तस्या यजमानः सितांबरः..
पुरः स्थितोंजलिं बद्ध्वा मंत्रानेतानुदाहरेत्..22..
5.267.m:
Having performed all this for her, the patron, dressed in white garments,
standing before her with joined palms, should utter these mantras:

5.267.s:
tvayā saṃdhāryate viśvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram..
tava dānaṃ kariṣyāmi sāṃnidhyaṃ kuru medini..23..
5.267.d:
त्वया संधार्यते विश्वं जगदेतच्चराचरम्..
तव दानं करिष्यामि सांनिध्यं कुरु मेदिनि..23..
5.267.m:
'By you the universe is upheld, this entire moving and unmoving world.
I shall make a gift of you; grant your presence, O Earth!

5.267.s:
śarīreṣvapi bhūtānāṃ tvaṃ devi prathamaṃ sthitā..
tataścānyāni bhūtāni jalādīni vasundhare..24..
5.267.d:
शरीरेष्वपि भूतानां त्वं देवि प्रथमं स्थिता..
ततश्चान्यानि भूतानि जलादीनि वसुन्धरे..24..
5.267.m:
Even in the bodies of living beings, O goddess, you exist first;
and then the other elements, beginning with water, O Earth!

5.267.s:
ye tvāṃ yacchaṃti te bhūyastvāṃ labhaṃte na saṃśayaḥ..
iha loke pare caiva pārthivaṃ rūpamāśritā..25..
5.267.d:
ये त्वां यच्छंति ते भूयस्त्वां लभंते न संशयः..
इह लोके परे चैव पार्थिवं रूपमाश्रिता..25..
5.267.m:
Those who give you, obtain you again, without a doubt,
in this world and in the next, resting in royal form.'

5.267.s:
evaṃ stutvā samādāya toyaṃ hemākṛtiṃ nṛpa..
vāsudevaṃ hṛdi sthāpya maṃtreṇānena kalpayet..26..
5.267.d:
एवं स्तुत्वा समादाय तोयं हेमाकृतिं नृप..
वासुदेवं हृदि स्थाप्य मंत्रेणानेन कल्पयेत्..26..
5.267.m:
Having thus praised her and taken water, O king, [and] the golden form,
fixing Vāsudeva in one's heart, one should dedicate it with this mantra:

5.267.s:
pātālāduddhṛtā yena pṛthvī sā lokakāriṇā..
asyā dānena ca sadā prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ..27..
5.267.d:
पातालादुद्धृता येन पृथ्वी सा लोककारिणा..
अस्या दानेन च सदा प्रीयतां मे जनार्दनः..27..
5.267.m:
'By whom that earth was lifted up from Pātāla, the creator of the world—
by the gift of this [earth], may Janārdana always be pleased with me!'

5.267.s:
evamuccārya tattoyaṃ toyamadhye parikṣipet..
na bhūmau naiva haste ca brāhmaṇasya nṛpottama..28..
5.267.d:
एवमुच्चार्य तत्तोयं तोयमध्ये परिक्षिपेत्..
न भूमौ नैव हस्ते च ब्राह्मणस्य नृपोत्तम..28..
5.267.m:
Having spoken thus, one should cast that water into the midst of water,
not on the ground, nor into the hand of the brahmin, O best of kings.

5.267.s:
tato visarjayeddevīṃ mantreṇānena bhāgaśaḥ..
āgatā ca yathānyāyaṃ pūjitā ca yathāvidhi..29..
5.267.d:
ततो विसर्जयेद्देवीं मन्त्रेणानेन भागशः..
आगता च यथान्यायं पूजिता च यथाविधि..29..
5.267.m:
Then one should dismiss the goddess in parts with this mantra:
'You have arrived according to proper method and have been worshipped according to rule.

5.267.s:
asmākaṃ tvaṃ hitārthāya yatreṣṭaṃ tatra gamyatām..
usrā vedeti maṃtreṇa samuccārya tataḥ param..
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradātavyā saṃvibhajya narādhipa..6.268.30..
5.267.d:
अस्माकं त्वं हितार्थाय यत्रेष्टं तत्र गम्यताम्..
उस्रा वेदेति मंत्रेण समुच्चार्य ततः परम्..
ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदातव्या संविभज्य नराधिप..6.268.30..
5.267.m:
For our welfare, go wherever it is desired.'
Having recited beyond that with the mantra 'usrā veda,'
it is to be given to the brahmins after dividing it, O ruler of men.

5.267.s:
evaṃ te sarvamākhyātaṃ pṛthivīdānamuttamam.
śṛṇuyātpārthivo bhāvī dātā janmanijanmani..31..
5.267.d:
एवं ते सर्वमाख्यातं पृथिवीदानमुत्तमम्.
शृणुयात्पार्थिवो भावी दाता जन्मनिजन्मनि..31..
5.267.m:
Thus has the supreme gift of the earth been entirely recounted to you.
The king who hears it will become a giver [of land] birth after birth.

5.267.s:
yo rājā pṛthivīṃ dadyādvidhinānena pārthiva..
rājyabhraṃśo na vaṃśe'pi tasya saṃjāyate kvacit..32..
5.267.d:
यो राजा पृथिवीं दद्याद्विधिनानेन पार्थिव..
राज्यभ्रंशो न वंशेऽपि तस्य संजायते क्वचित्..32..
5.267.m:
Whatever king gives the earth according to this rite, O ruler of the earth,
fall from kingship never occurs, even in his lineage.

5.267.s:
rājyabhraṃśasamopetā ye dṛśyaṃte mahībhujaḥ..
na tairvasundharā dattā brāhmaṇānāṃ dhṛtātmanām..33..
5.267.d:
राज्यभ्रंशसमोपेता ये दृश्यंते महीभुजः..
न तैर्वसुन्धरा दत्ता ब्राह्मणानां धृतात्मनाम्..33..
5.267.m:
Those rulers of the earth who are seen to suffer the loss of their kingdom—
by them the earth was not given to self-controlled brahmins.

5.267.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pṛthvīdānaṃ samācaret..
na haretparadattāṃ ca kathaṃcidapi medinīm..34..
5.267.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन पृथ्वीदानं समाचरेत्..
न हरेत्परदत्तां च कथंचिदपि मेदिनीम्..34..
5.267.m:
Therefore, with every effort one should perform the gift of the earth,
and one must never, in any way, take away land given by another.

5.267.s:
etatpuṇyaṃ praśasyaṃ ca pṛthivīdānamuttamam..
śṛṇvatāmapi rājeṃdra taddehādyaghanāśanam..35..
5.267.d:
एतत्पुण्यं प्रशस्यं च पृथिवीदानमुत्तमम्..
शृण्वतामपि राजेंद्र तद्देहाद्यघनाशनम्..35..
5.267.m:
This is meritorious and praiseworthy, the supreme gift of the earth;
even for those who hear of it, O king of kings, it destroys the sins of the body and beyond.

5.267.s:
āstāṃ tāvatpradānaṃ ca pṛthivyāḥ pṛthivīpateḥ..
dātuḥ saṃpreraṇaṃ yasyā ajñānaughavināśanam..36..
5.267.d:
आस्तां तावत्प्रदानं च पृथिव्याः पृथिवीपतेः..
दातुः संप्रेरणं यस्या अज्ञानौघविनाशनम्..36..
5.267.m:
Let alone the gift of the earth by a ruler of the earth:
even instigating the donor of it destroys the flood of ignorance.

5.267.s:
rūpavānsubhagaścaiva tathā ca priyadarśanaḥ..
ādhivyādhivinirmuktaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ..37..
5.267.d:
रूपवान्सुभगश्चैव तथा च प्रियदर्शनः..
आधिव्याधिविनिर्मुक्तः पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः..37..
5.267.m:
Handsome, fortunate, and pleasing in appearance,
freed from mental anguish and physical disease, accompanied by sons and grandsons,

5.267.s:
medhāvī jāyate martyo dānasyāsya prabhāvataḥ..
itthaṃbhūtā mahārāja kṛtvā rājyamakaṇṭakam..38..
5.267.d:
मेधावी जायते मर्त्यो दानस्यास्य प्रभावतः..
इत्थंभूता महाराज कृत्वा राज्यमकण्टकम्..38..
5.267.m:
intelligent does a mortal become by the power of this gift.
Having become like this, O great king, and having ruled an unthreatened kingdom,

5.267.s:
prītā viṣṇoḥ padaṃ yāṃti śāśvataṃ yannirāmayam..
anyatrāpi dharādānātprakuryāccakravartitām..39..
5.267.d:
प्रीता विष्णोः पदं यांति शाश्वतं यन्निरामयम्..
अन्यत्रापि धरादानात्प्रकुर्याच्चक्रवर्तिताम्..39..
5.267.m:
they go, satisfied, to the eternal, painless abode of Viṣṇu.
From the gift of the earth even elsewhere, one would attain universal emperorship

5.267.s:
ekajanmāṃtaraṃ yāvatsamyagdattaṃ nṛpottamaḥ..
gautameśvaradevasya yatpurā purataḥ kṛtam..6.268.40..
5.267.d:
एकजन्मांतरं यावत्सम्यग्दत्तं नृपोत्तमः..
गौतमेश्वरदेवस्य यत्पुरा पुरतः कृतम्..6.268.40..
5.267.m:
for the duration of a single subsequent birth, when properly given, O best of kings.
That which was formerly made in the presence of the god Gautameśvara

5.267.s:
saptajanmāṃtaraṃ yāvatprakaroti na saṃśayaḥ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra deyā mahī nṛpa..41..
5.267.d:
सप्तजन्मांतरं यावत्प्रकरोति न संशयः..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तत्र देया मही नृप..41..
5.267.m:
makes [one an emperor] for seven successive births, without a doubt.
Therefore, with every effort, the earth is to be given there, O king.

5.267.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye gautameśvaramāhātmye pṛthvīdānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ..268..
5.267.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गौतमेश्वरमाहात्म्ये पृथ्वीदानमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टषष्ट्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः..268..
5.267.m: Thus ends the two hundred and sixty-eighth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of the Gift of the Earth' in the Gautameśvara-māhātmya within the Hāṭakeśvarakṣetra-māhātmya, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skandamahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.268.s:
sūta uvāca..
kapāleśasya māhātmyaṃ śrūyatāmadhunā dvijāḥ..
caturthasya mahābhāgāstatra kṣetre sthitasya ca..1..
śrutamātreṇa yenātra naraḥ pāpātpramucyate..2..
5.268.d:
सूत उवाच..
कपालेशस्य माहात्म्यं श्रूयतामधुना द्विजाः..
चतुर्थस्य महाभागास्तत्र क्षेत्रे स्थितस्य च..1..
श्रुतमात्रेण येनात्र नरः पापात्प्रमुच्यते..2..
5.268.m:
Sūta said:
Now let the greatness of Kapāleśa be heard, O twice-born ones,
the fourth [deity], O fortunate ones, residing in that sacred field,
by the mere hearing of which a person here is freed from sin.

5.268.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
trayāṇāṃ caiva liṃgānāṃ pūrvoktānāṃ mahāmate..
śrutāsmābhiḥ samutpattiḥkapāleśvaravarjitā..
kenāyaṃ sthāpito devaḥ kapāleśvarasaṃjñitaḥ.. 3..
5.268.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः..
त्रयाणां चैव लिंगानां पूर्वोक्तानां महामते..
श्रुतास्माभिः समुत्पत्तिःकपालेश्वरवर्जिता..
केनायं स्थापितो देवः कपालेश्वरसंज्ञितः.. 3..
5.268.m:
The seers said:
O wise one, we have heard the origin of the three liṅgas
mentioned earlier, but not that of Kapāleśvara.
By whom was this god named Kapāleśvara established?

5.268.s: tasmindṛṣṭe phalaṃ kiṃ syātpūjite ca vadasva naḥ..4..
5.268.d: तस्मिन्दृष्टे फलं किं स्यात्पूजिते च वदस्व नः..4..
5.268.m: Tell us: what is the fruit when he is seen, and when he is worshipped?

5.268.s:
sūta uvāca..
iṃdreṇa sthāpitaḥ pūrvameṣa devo dvijottamāḥ..
kapāleśvasaṃjñastu brahmahatyā vimuktaye..5..
5.268.d:
सूत उवाच..
इंद्रेण स्थापितः पूर्वमेष देवो द्विजोत्तमाः..
कपालेश्वसंज्ञस्तु ब्रह्महत्या विमुक्तये..5..
5.268.m:
Sūta said:
Formerly, this god named Kapāleśvara was installed by Indra,
O best of the twice-born, for release from the killing of a brahmin.

5.268.s:
tatprabhāvatsuraśreṣṭha stayā mukte dvijottamāḥ..
pāpaṃ pūruṣadānena ityeṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ....
anyo'pi yo narastaṃ ca pūjayitvā prabhaktitaḥ..
prayacchedbrāhmaṇendrāya śuddhaye pāpapūruṣam..
sa mucyetpātakādghorādbrahmahatyāsamudbhavāt..7..
5.268.d:
तत्प्रभावत्सुरश्रेष्ठ स्तया मुक्ते द्विजोत्तमाः..
पापं पूरुषदानेन इत्येषा वैदिकी श्रुतिः....
अन्योऽपि यो नरस्तं च पूजयित्वा प्रभक्तितः..
प्रयच्छेद्ब्राह्मणेन्द्राय शुद्धये पापपूरुषम्..
स मुच्येत्पातकाद्घोराद्ब्रह्महत्यासमुद्भवात्..7..
5.268.m:
By his power, O best of the twice-born, the foremost of the gods was released from it
through the gift of the 'person of sin'—such is the Vedic scripture.
Any other man also who, having worshipped him with devotion,
presents the 'person of sin' to an eminent brahmin for purification,
he is freed from the terrible sin born of the killing of a brahmin.

5.268.s:
dakṣiṇāmūrtimāsādya provācedaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre gatvā taṃ vīkṣya śaṃkaram..8..
5.268.d:
दक्षिणामूर्तिमासाद्य प्रोवाचेदं बृहस्पतिः..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे गत्वा तं वीक्ष्य शंकरम्..8..
5.268.m:
Approaching Dakṣiṇāmūrti, Bṛhaspati said this:
'Having gone to the sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara and having beheld that Śaṃkara,

5.268.s:
yo dadāti śarīraṃ ca kṛtvā hemamayaṃ tataḥ..
mucyate nātra saṃdehaḥ pātakaiḥ pūrvasaṃyutaiḥ..9..
5.268.d:
यो ददाति शरीरं च कृत्वा हेममयं ततः..
मुच्यते नात्र संदेहः पातकैः पूर्वसंयुतैः..9..
5.268.m:
he who then gives a body made of gold
is freed from past sins; of this there is no doubt.'

5.268.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
brahmahatyā kathaṃ jātā surendrasya hi sūtaja..
etannaḥ sarvamācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ..6.269.10..
5.268.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः..
ब्रह्महत्या कथं जाता सुरेन्द्रस्य हि सूतज..
एतन्नः सर्वमाचक्ष्व परं कौतूहलं हि नः..6.269.10..
5.268.m:
The seers said:
How did the killing of a brahmin befall the lord of gods, O son of Sūta?
Relate all of this to us, for our curiosity is immense.

5.268.s:
kapāleśvarasaṃjñastu kathaṃ devo'tra saṃsthitaḥ..
brahmahatyā kathaṃ naṣṭā tatprabhāvāddivaspateḥ..11..
5.268.d:
कपालेश्वरसंज्ञस्तु कथं देवोऽत्र संस्थितः..
ब्रह्महत्या कथं नष्टा तत्प्रभावाद्दिवस्पतेः..11..
5.268.m:
How is the god named Kapāleśvara established here?
How was the killing of a brahmin destroyed for the lord of heaven by his power?

5.268.s:
sa pāpapūruṣo deyo vidhinā kena sūtaja..
kairmaṃtraiḥ sa hi deyaḥ kaiścaiva hyupaskaraiḥ..12..
5.268.d:
स पापपूरुषो देयो विधिना केन सूतज..
कैर्मंत्रैः स हि देयः कैश्चैव ह्युपस्करैः..12..
5.268.m:
By what rite is that 'person of sin' to be given, O son of Sūta?
With which mantras should he be given, and with which accessories?

5.268.s:
darśanātpūjanāccāpi kiṃ phalaṃ jāyate nṛṇām..
adattvā svaśarīraṃ vā pūjayā kevalaṃ vada..13..
5.268.d:
दर्शनात्पूजनाच्चापि किं फलं जायते नृणाम्..
अदत्त्वा स्वशरीरं वा पूजया केवलं वद..13..
5.268.m:
What fruit arises for men from beholding and from worshipping?
Tell [us]: without giving one's own body, [what fruit comes] by mere worship?

5.268.s:
sūta uvāca..
ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi kathāmetāṃ purātanīm..
yāṃ śrutvāpi mahābhāgā naraḥ pāpātpramucyate..14..
5.268.d:
सूत उवाच..
अहं वः कीर्तयिष्यामि कथामेतां पुरातनीम्..
यां श्रुत्वापि महाभागा नरः पापात्प्रमुच्यते..14..
5.268.m: Sūta said: / I will narrate to you this ancient tale, / upon hearing which, O fortunate ones, a man is released from sin.

5.268.s:
ajñānājjñānato vāpi vihitairanyajanmajaiḥ..
dṛṣṭamātreṇa yenātra pātakāttaddinodbhavāt..
mucyate nātra saṃdehaḥ satyametanmayoditam..15..
5.268.d:
अज्ञानाज्ज्ञानतो वापि विहितैरन्यजन्मजैः..
दृष्टमात्रेण येनात्र पातकात्तद्दिनोद्भवात्..
मुच्यते नात्र संदेहः सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम्..15..
5.268.m: [Committed] through ignorance or knowledge, or born of other births; / by merely seeing [this], he is freed from the sin born of that day— / of this there is no doubt; this truth has been spoken by me.

5.268.s:
purā tvaṣṭuḥ suto jajñe vṛtro hi dvijasattamāḥ..
pulomaduhituḥ pārśvādvibhāvaryāḥ suvīryavān..16..
5.268.d:
पुरा त्वष्टुः सुतो जज्ञे वृत्रो हि द्विजसत्तमाः..
पुलोमदुहितुः पार्श्वाद्विभावर्याः सुवीर्यवान्..16..
5.268.m: Formerly, O best of brahmins, Tvaṣṭṛ's son Vṛtra was born, / possessing great valor, from Puloman's daughter Vibhāvarī.

5.268.s:
sa bāla eva dharmātmā āsītsarvajanapriyaḥ..
dānavaṃ bhāvamutsṛjya dvijabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ..17..
5.268.d:
स बाल एव धर्मात्मा आसीत्सर्वजनप्रियः..
दानवं भावमुत्सृज्य द्विजभक्तिपरायणः..17..
5.268.m: Even as a boy he was righteous and dear to all people; / abandoning demonic nature, he was devoted to worshipping brahmins.

5.268.s:
sa gatvā puṣkarāraṇyaṃ parameṇa samādhinā..
toṣayāmāsa deveśaṃ padmajaṃ tapasi sthitaḥ..18..
5.268.d:
स गत्वा पुष्करारण्यं परमेण समाधिना..
तोषयामास देवेशं पद्मजं तपसि स्थितः..18..
5.268.m: Having gone to the Puṣkara forest with supreme concentration, / standing in austerity, he satisfied the lotus-born lord of the gods.

5.268.s:
tasya tuṣṭaḥ svayaṃ brahmā dṛṣṭigocaramāgataḥ..
provāca varado'smīti kiṃ te kṛtyaṃ karomyaham..19..
5.268.d:
तस्य तुष्टः स्वयं ब्रह्मा दृष्टिगोचरमागतः..
प्रोवाच वरदोऽस्मीति किं ते कृत्यं करोम्यहम्..19..
5.268.m: Pleased with him, Brahmā himself came into the range of his sight / and said, "I am a granter of boons; what task may I perform for you?"

5.268.s:
vṛtra uvāca..
yadi tuṣṭosi me deva brāhmaṇatvaṃ prayaccha me.
brāhmaṇatvaṃ samāsādya sādhayāmi paraṃ padam..6.269.20..
5.268.d:
वृत्र उवाच..
यदि तुष्टोसि मे देव ब्राह्मणत्वं प्रयच्छ मे.
ब्राह्मणत्वं समासाद्य साधयामि परं पदम्..6.269.20..
5.268.m: Vṛtra said: / "If you are pleased with me, O god, grant me brahminhood! / Attaining brahminhood, I shall achieve the supreme state.

5.268.s:
tena kiṃcidasādhyaṃ na brāhmaṇyena bhavenmama..
brāhmaṇena samaṃ cānyanna kiṃcitpratibhāti me..21..
5.268.d:
तेन किंचिदसाध्यं न ब्राह्मण्येन भवेन्मम..
ब्राह्मणेन समं चान्यन्न किंचित्प्रतिभाति मे..21..
5.268.m: Through that brahminhood, nothing would be impossible for me; / and nothing else seems equal to a brahmin in my sight.

5.268.s:
paramaṃ daivataṃ kiṃcinna viprādvidyate param..
tasmānme hṛtsthitaṃ nānyadapi rājyaṃ triviṣṭape..22..
5.268.d:
परमं दैवतं किंचिन्न विप्राद्विद्यते परम्..
तस्मान्मे हृत्स्थितं नान्यदपि राज्यं त्रिविष्टपे..22..
5.268.m: There is no supreme divinity higher than a brahmin; / therefore, nothing else stays in my heart, not even kingship in heaven."

5.268.s:
sūta uvāca..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tuṣṭastasya pitāmahaḥ..
brāhmaṇatvaṃ svayaṃ dattvā tataḥ provāca sādaram..23..
5.268.d:
सूत उवाच..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा तुष्टस्तस्य पितामहः..
ब्राह्मणत्वं स्वयं दत्त्वा ततः प्रोवाच सादरम्..23..
5.268.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that speech of his, the Grandfather was pleased with him; / granting brahminhood himself, he then said with respect:

5.268.s:
mayā tvaṃ vihito vipra putra prakuru vāṃchitam..
prasādayasva satataṃ brāhmaṇānbrahmavittamān..24..
5.268.d:
मया त्वं विहितो विप्र पुत्र प्रकुरु वांछितम्..
प्रसादयस्व सततं ब्राह्मणान्ब्रह्मवित्तमान्..24..
5.268.m: "You have been made a brahmin by me, my son; fulfill your desire. / Continually propitiate the brahmins who know Brahman best.

5.268.s:
brāhmaṇaiḥ suprasannaiśca prīyaṃte sarvadevatāḥ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjanīyā dvijottamāḥ..25..
5.268.d:
ब्राह्मणैः सुप्रसन्नैश्च प्रीयंते सर्वदेवताः..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन पूजनीया द्विजोत्तमाः..25..
5.268.m: When brahmins are well-pleased, all deities are delighted; / therefore, the best of brahmins are to be worshipped with every effort."

5.268.s:
sūta uvāca..
evamuktastadā tena vṛtro'bhūdbrāhmaṇastataḥ..
brāhmyā lakṣmyā samopeto brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ..26..
5.268.d:
सूत उवाच..
एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन वृत्रोऽभूद्ब्राह्मणस्ततः..
ब्राह्म्या लक्ष्म्या समोपेतो ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणः..26..
5.268.m: Sūta said: / Addressed thus by him at that time, Vṛtra then became a brahmin, / endowed with brahmic splendor, devoted to student-chastity.

5.268.s:
tasmiṃstapasi saṃsthe tu hatā iṃdreṇa dānavāḥ..
vaṃśocchede samāpanne dānavānāṃ mahātmanām..27..
5.268.d:
तस्मिंस्तपसि संस्थे तु हता इंद्रेण दानवाः..
वंशोच्छेदे समापन्ने दानवानां महात्मनाम्..27..
5.268.m: While he was engaged in that austerity, the Dānavas were slain by Indra; / when destruction of the lineage befell the high-souled Dānavas,

5.268.s:
tataste dānavāḥ sarve parābhūtāḥ suraistataḥ..
svaṃ sthānaṃ saṃparityajya duḥkhaśokasamanvitāḥ..28..
5.268.d:
ततस्ते दानवाः सर्वे पराभूताः सुरैस्ततः..
स्वं स्थानं संपरित्यज्य दुःखशोकसमन्विताः..28..
5.268.m: then all those Dānavas, defeated by the gods, / completely abandoned their own abode, filled with grief and sorrow.

5.268.s:
tanmātaraṃ puraskṛtvā tatsakāśamupāgatāḥ..
sa ca tāṃ mātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā vṛtāṃ taiśca samanvitaḥ..29..
5.268.d:
तन्मातरं पुरस्कृत्वा तत्सकाशमुपागताः..
स च तां मातरं दृष्ट्वा वृतां तैश्च समन्वितः..29..
5.268.m: Placing his mother in front, they approached him. / And seeing that mother of his accompanied and surrounded by them,

5.268.s:
dānavaiśca parābhūtaistathābhūtāṃ ca mātaram..
kimāgamanakṛtyaṃ ca duḥkhitānāṃ mamāṃtike..6.269.30..
5.268.d:
दानवैश्च पराभूतैस्तथाभूतां च मातरम्..
किमागमनकृत्यं च दुःखितानां ममांतिके..6.269.30..
5.268.m: the Dānavas who were defeated, and his mother in such a state, [he asked:] / "What is the reason for the arrival of you distressed ones before me?"

5.268.s:
dānavā ūcuḥ..
vayaṃ devaiḥ parābhūtā bhavaṃtaṃ śaraṇāgatāḥ..
kva yāmo'nyatra cā'smākaṃ tvāṃ vinā nāsti saṃśrayaḥ..31..
5.268.d:
दानवा ऊचुः..
वयं देवैः पराभूता भवंतं शरणागताः..
क्व यामोऽन्यत्र चाऽस्माकं त्वां विना नास्ति संश्रयः..31..
5.268.m: The Dānavas said: / "Defeated by the gods, we have come to you for refuge. / Where else may we go? There is no shelter for us without you."

5.268.s:
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vṛtraḥ provāca sādaram..
devānahaṃ haniṣyāmi gamyatāṃ tatra mā ciram..32..
5.268.d:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वृत्रः प्रोवाच सादरम्..
देवानहं हनिष्यामि गम्यतां तत्र मा चिरम्..32..
5.268.m: Hearing their words, Vṛtra said with respect: / "I will slay the gods; go there without delay.

5.268.s: tavāgamanakṛtyaṃ ca mātaḥ kathaya sāṃpratam..33..
5.268.d: तवागमनकृत्यं च मातः कथय सांप्रतम्..33..
5.268.m: And mother, tell now the reason for your coming."

5.268.s:
mātovāca..
tathā kuru mahābhāga śīghraṃ dāraparigraham..
vaṃśavṛddhau pramāṇaṃ cedvākyaṃ tava mamodbhavam..34..
5.268.d:
मातोवाच..
तथा कुरु महाभाग शीघ्रं दारपरिग्रहम्..
वंशवृद्धौ प्रमाणं चेद्वाक्यं तव ममोद्भवम्..34..
5.268.m: The mother said: / "Do so, O fortunate one: quickly accept a wife! / For the growth of the lineage, if my word born [of affection] has authority for you.

5.268.s:
eṣa eva paro dharma eṣa eva paro nayaḥ..
putrasya jananīvākyaṃ yatkaroti samāhitaḥ.. 35..
5.268.d:
एष एव परो धर्म एष एव परो नयः..
पुत्रस्य जननीवाक्यं यत्करोति समाहितः.. 35..
5.268.m: This alone is the supreme dharma, this alone is the highest conduct: / that a son attentively obeys the words of his mother.

5.268.s:
tathā strīṇāṃ patiṃ muktvā nānyāsti bhuvi devatā..
jananyāṃ jīvamānāyāṃ tathaiva ca sutasya ca..36..
5.268.d:
तथा स्त्रीणां पतिं मुक्त्वा नान्यास्ति भुवि देवता..
जनन्यां जीवमानायां तथैव च सुतस्य च..36..
5.268.m: Likewise, for women on earth there is no deity other than a husband; / and likewise for a son, while his mother is living.

5.268.s:
atikramya ca yā nārī patiṃ dharmaparā bhavet..
tatsarvaṃ viphalaṃ tasyā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ..37..
5.268.d:
अतिक्रम्य च या नारी पतिं धर्मपरा भवेत्..
तत्सर्वं विफलं तस्या जायते नात्र संशयः..37..
5.268.m: And whatever woman transgresses her husband to pursue religious duty, / all of that becomes fruitless for her; there is no doubt about this.

5.268.s:
putraḥ svajananīvākyaṃ yo'tikramya yathāruci..
karoti dharmakṛtyāni tāni sarvāṇi tasya ca..38..
5.268.d:
पुत्रः स्वजननीवाक्यं योऽतिक्रम्य यथारुचि..
करोति धर्मकृत्यानि तानि सर्वाणि तस्य च..38..
5.268.m: Whatever son, transgressing his own mother's words as he pleases, / performs religious acts, all those of his

5.268.s:
bhavaṃti ca tathā nūnaṃ vṛthā bhasmahutaṃ yathā..
araṇye ruditānīva ūṣare vāpitāni ca..39..
5.268.d:
भवंति च तथा नूनं वृथा भस्महुतं यथा..
अरण्ये रुदितानीव ऊषरे वापितानि च..39..
5.268.m: truly become in vain, just like an oblation poured on ashes, / or like weeping in a forest, or seeds sown on barren ground;

5.268.s:
yathaiva badhirasyāgre gītaṃ nṛtyamacakṣuṣaḥ..
tadvanmātṛmatādanyakṛtaṃ putrasya dharmajam..6.269.40..
5.268.d:
यथैव बधिरस्याग्रे गीतं नृत्यमचक्षुषः..
तद्वन्मातृमतादन्यकृतं पुत्रस्य धर्मजम्..6.269.40..
5.268.m: just like singing before a deaf person or dancing before a blind person, / so is anything born of dharma done by a son against his mother's wish.

5.268.s:
sarvaṃ karma na saṃdehastenāhaṃ tvāmupāgatā..
baṃdhūnāṃ vacanātputra duḥkhārtā ca viśeṣataḥ..41..
5.268.d:
सर्वं कर्म न संदेहस्तेनाहं त्वामुपागता..
बंधूनां वचनात्पुत्र दुःखार्ता च विशेषतः..41..
5.268.m: Every deed [is futile], no doubt; therefore I have approached you / at the word of our kinsmen, my son, and especially afflicted with grief.

5.268.s:
kiṃ vā te bahunoktena bhūyo bhūyaśca putraka..
ānṛṇyaṃ jāyate yadvatpitṝṇāṃ tattathā śṛṇu..42..
5.268.d:
किं वा ते बहुनोक्तेन भूयो भूयश्च पुत्रक..
आनृण्यं जायते यद्वत्पितॄणां तत्तथा शृणु..42..
5.268.m: Or what need is there to say much to you again and again, my dear son? / Hear how freedom from debt to the ancestors comes about.

5.268.s:
tava vatsa pramāṇaṃ cetkuruṣva ca vaco mama..
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā vṛtraḥ saṃciṃtya cetasi..43..
5.268.d:
तव वत्स प्रमाणं चेत्कुरुष्व च वचो मम..
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वृत्रः संचिंत्य चेतसि..43..
5.268.m: If my word has authority for you, my child, then carry it out." / Hearing those words of hers and reflecting in his mind,

5.268.s:
śrutismṛtyuktamārgeṇa na māturvidyate param..
sa tatheti pratijñāya ānināya parigraham..44..
5.268.d:
श्रुतिस्मृत्युक्तमार्गेण न मातुर्विद्यते परम्..
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय आनिनाय परिग्रहम्..44..
5.268.m: "According to the path declared by Śruti and Smṛti, there is nothing higher than a mother," / he agreed with "So be it!" and took a wife.

5.268.s:
tvaṣṭā tasmai dadau prītastato ratnānyanekaśaḥ..
saṃkhyāhīnāni tasyaiva kupyākupyamanaṃtakam..45..
5.268.d:
त्वष्टा तस्मै ददौ प्रीतस्ततो रत्नान्यनेकशः..
संख्याहीनानि तस्यैव कुप्याकुप्यमनंतकम्..45..
5.268.m: Then Tvaṣṭṛ, delighted, gave him numerous jewels, / countless, and infinite base and precious metals.

5.268.s:
hastyaśvayānakośāḍhyaṃ so'bhiṣiktaḥ pade nije..
dānavānāṃ mahāvīryo brāhmaṇyena samanvitaḥ..46..
5.268.d:
हस्त्यश्वयानकोशाढ्यं सोऽभिषिक्तः पदे निजे..
दानवानां महावीर्यो ब्राह्मण्येन समन्वितः..46..
5.268.m: Rich in elephants, horses, chariots, and treasuries, he of great valor, / endowed with brahminhood, was consecrated in his own station over the Dānavas.

5.268.s:
abhiṣiktaṃ tadā vṛtraṃ svarājye te'surādayaḥ..
śrutvābhiṣekaṃ saṃhṛṣṭāstasya vṛtrasya bāṃdhavāḥ..47..
5.268.d:
अभिषिक्तं तदा वृत्रं स्वराज्ये तेऽसुरादयः..
श्रुत्वाभिषेकं संहृष्टास्तस्य वृत्रस्य बांधवाः..47..
5.268.m: When Vṛtra was then consecrated in his own kingdom, those Asuras and others— / his kinsmen were overjoyed upon hearing of Vṛtra's consecration.

5.268.s:
dānavāśca samājagmurye tatrāsanpurogatāḥ..
pātālādgiridurgācca sthaladurgebhya eva ca..
kṛtavairāḥ samaṃ devaiḥ kopena mahatā vṛtāḥ.. 48..
5.268.d:
दानवाश्च समाजग्मुर्ये तत्रासन्पुरोगताः..
पातालाद्गिरिदुर्गाच्च स्थलदुर्गेभ्य एव च..
कृतवैराः समं देवैः कोपेन महता वृताः.. 48..
5.268.m: And the Dānavas who were situated in front assembled there / from Pātāla, mountain fortresses, and land fortresses, / filled with great wrath, having made enmity with the gods.

5.268.s:
tataḥ protsāhitaḥ sarvairdānavaiḥ sa mahābalaḥ..
prasthitaḥ śatrunāśāya mahendrabhavanaṃ prati..49..
5.268.d:
ततः प्रोत्साहितः सर्वैर्दानवैः स महाबलः..
प्रस्थितः शत्रुनाशाय महेन्द्रभवनं प्रति..49..
5.268.m: Then, urged on by all the Dānavas, that mighty one / set out toward Mahendra's abode to destroy his enemies.

5.268.s:
śakro'pi vṛtramākarṇya samāyāṃtaṃ yuyutsayā..
sanmukhaḥ prayayau hṛṣṭaḥ sarvadevasamanvitaḥ..6.269.50..
5.268.d:
शक्रोऽपि वृत्रमाकर्ण्य समायांतं युयुत्सया..
सन्मुखः प्रययौ हृष्टः सर्वदेवसमन्वितः..6.269.50..
5.268.m: Hearing that Vṛtra was approaching with a desire to fight, / Śakra too, delighted, set forth facing him, accompanied by all the gods.

5.268.s:
tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha..
merupṛṣṭhe suvistīrṇe nityameva divāniśam..51..
5.268.d:
ततः समभवद्युद्धं देवानां दानवैः सह..
मेरुपृष्ठे सुविस्तीर्णे नित्यमेव दिवानिशम्..51..
5.268.m: Then a battle took place between the gods and the Dānavas / on the vast ridge of Mount Meru, continually day and night.

5.268.s:
nityaṃ parājayo jajñe devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha..
tatrovāca guruḥ śakra mā yuddhaṃ kuru devapa..52..
5.268.d:
नित्यं पराजयो जज्ञे देवानां दानवैः सह..
तत्रोवाच गुरुः शक्र मा युद्धं कुरु देवप..52..
5.268.m: Defeat constantly befell the gods against the Dānavas. / There the guru spoke: "O Śakra, lord of the gods, do not fight!

5.268.s:
vṛtro'yaṃ dāruṇo yuddhe baladvayasamanvitaḥ..
catvāraścāgrato vedāḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ saśaraṃ dhanuḥ..53..
5.268.d:
वृत्रोऽयं दारुणो युद्धे बलद्वयसमन्वितः..
चत्वारश्चाग्रतो वेदाः पृष्ठतः सशरं धनुः..53..
5.268.m: This Vṛtra is fierce in battle, endowed with two kinds of power: / the four Vedas are in front of him, and behind him is a bow with arrows.

5.268.s:
tena jeyatamo daityastavaiva ca mahāhave..
tasmātsaṃdhānametena tvaṃ kuruṣva śacīpate..54..
5.268.d:
तेन जेयतमो दैत्यस्तवैव च महाहवे..
तस्मात्संधानमेतेन त्वं कुरुष्व शचीपते..54..
5.268.m: Therefore, that Daitya is most capable of defeating you in the great battle. / For that reason, make an alliance with him, O husband of Śacī!

5.268.s:
tato viśvāsamāyā taṃ jahi vajreṇa dānavam..
ṣaḍupāyai ripurvadhya iti śāstranidarśanam..55..
5.268.d:
ततो विश्वासमाया तं जहि वज्रेण दानवम्..
षडुपायै रिपुर्वध्य इति शास्त्रनिदर्शनम्..55..
5.268.m: Then, when he has gained confidence, slay that Dānava with your thunderbolt! / 'An enemy should be slain by the six means'—such is the precept of the treatises.

5.268.s:
bhuṃjānaśca śayānaśca dattvā kanyāmapi svakām..
vipradānena saṃyojya kṛtvāpi śapathaṃ gurum..
māyāprapaṃcamāsādya tasmādevaṃ samācara..56..
5.268.d:
भुंजानश्च शयानश्च दत्त्वा कन्यामपि स्वकाम्..
विप्रदानेन संयोज्य कृत्वापि शपथं गुरुम्..
मायाप्रपंचमासाद्य तस्मादेवं समाचर..56..
5.268.m: While eating or sleeping, by even giving your own daughter, / by binding [him] through gifting brahmins, or even having taken a solemn oath— / resorting to the fabric of illusion, act in this way!"

5.268.s:
indra uvāca..
yadyevaṃ ca svayaṃ gatvā tvaṃ viśvāse niyojaya..
tava vākyena viśvāsaṃ nūnaṃ yāsyati dānavaḥ..57..
5.268.d:
इन्द्र उवाच..
यद्येवं च स्वयं गत्वा त्वं विश्वासे नियोजय..
तव वाक्येन विश्वासं नूनं यास्यति दानवः..57..
5.268.m: Indra said: / "If it is so, go yourself and instill trust in him; / by your word the Dānava will surely attain confidence."

5.268.s:
sūta uvāca..
śakrasya matamājñāya pratasthe ca bṛhaspatiḥ..
yatra vṛtraḥ sthito daityo yuddhārthaṃ kṛtaniścayaḥ..58..
5.268.d:
सूत उवाच..
शक्रस्य मतमाज्ञाय प्रतस्थे च बृहस्पतिः..
यत्र वृत्रः स्थितो दैत्यो युद्धार्थं कृतनिश्चयः..58..
5.268.m:
Sūta said:
Having understood Śakra's view, Bṛhaspati set out
to where the Daitya Vṛtra stood, resolved upon war.

5.268.s:
vṛtro'pi taṃ samālokya svayaṃ prāptaṃ bṛhaspatim..
sadaiva dvijabhaktaḥ sa hṛṣṭātmā samapadyata..
viśeṣātpraṇipatyoccairvākyametadabhāṣata..59..
5.268.d:
वृत्रोऽपि तं समालोक्य स्वयं प्राप्तं बृहस्पतिम्..
सदैव द्विजभक्तः स हृष्टात्मा समपद्यत..
विशेषात्प्रणिपत्योच्चैर्वाक्यमेतदभाषत..59..
5.268.m:
Seeing that Bṛhaspati had arrived in person, Vṛtra too,
always devoted to brahmins, became delighted in mind. / He bowed down especially low and uttered these words:

5.268.s:
vṛtra uvāca..
svāgataṃ te dvijaśreṣṭha kiṃ karomi praśādhi mām..
priyā me brāhmaṇā yasmāttasmātkīrtaya sāṃpratam..6.269.60..
5.268.d:
वृत्र उवाच..
स्वागतं ते द्विजश्रेष्ठ किं करोमि प्रशाधि माम्..
प्रिया मे ब्राह्मणा यस्मात्तस्मात्कीर्तय सांप्रतम्..6.269.60..
5.268.m:
Vṛtra said:
Welcome to you, best of brahmins! What shall I do? Command me! / Since brahmins are dear to me, speak now!

5.268.s:
bṛhaspatiruvāca.. saṃdigdho vijayo yuddhe yasmāddaivena sattama..
tasmātkuru maheṃdreṇa vyavasthāṃ vacanānmama..61..
5.268.d:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच.. संदिग्धो विजयो युद्धे यस्माद्दैवेन सत्तम..
तस्मात्कुरु महेंद्रेण व्यवस्थां वचनान्मम..61..
5.268.m:
Bṛhaspati said:
Because victory in battle is uncertain due to fate, best of men, / therefore make a settlement with Mahendra at my word.

5.268.s:
tvaṃ bhuṃkṣva bhūtalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ śakraścāpi triviṣṭapam..
vyavasthayā'nayā nityaṃ vartitavyaṃ parasparam..62..
5.268.d:
त्वं भुंक्ष्व भूतलं कृत्स्नं शक्रश्चापि त्रिविष्टपम्..
व्यवस्थयाऽनया नित्यं वर्तितव्यं परस्परम्..62..
5.268.m: Enjoy you the entire earth, and Śakra the third heaven. / By this agreement you should always conduct yourselves mutually.

5.268.s:
vṛtra uvāca..
ahaṃ tava vaco brahmankariṣyāmi sadaiva hi.
saṃgamaṃ kuru śakreṇa sāṃprataṃ mama saddvija..63..
5.268.d:
वृत्र उवाच..
अहं तव वचो ब्रह्मन्करिष्यामि सदैव हि.
संगमं कुरु शक्रेण सांप्रतं मम सद्द्विज..63..
5.268.m:
Vṛtra said:
O brahmin, I shall always do your bidding. / O good brahmin, bring about an alliance between Śakra and me at once.

5.268.s:
sūta uvāca..
atha śakraṃ samānīya bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ..
vṛtreṇa saha saṃdhānaṃ cakre caiva parasparam..64..
5.268.d:
सूत उवाच..
अथ शक्रं समानीय बृहस्पतिरुदारधीः..
वृत्रेण सह संधानं चक्रे चैव परस्परम्..64..
5.268.m:
Sūta said:
Then Bṛhaspati of noble intellect, having brought Śakra there, / made a pact between him and Vṛtra.

5.268.s:
ekārimitratāṃ gatvā tāvubhau daityadevapau..
prahṛṣṭau gatavantau tau tataścaiva nijaṃ gṛham..65..
5.268.d:
एकारिमित्रतां गत्वा तावुभौ दैत्यदेवपौ..
प्रहृष्टौ गतवन्तौ तौ ततश्चैव निजं गृहम्..65..
5.268.m: Having entered into a mutual friendship, both rulers of the Daityas and the gods / rejoiced and departed from there to their own dwellings.

5.268.s:
atha śakracchalānveṣī sadā vṛtrasya vartate..
na cchidraṃ labhate kvāpi vīkṣamāṇopi yatnataḥ..66..
5.268.d:
अथ शक्रच्छलान्वेषी सदा वृत्रस्य वर्तते..
न च्छिद्रं लभते क्वापि वीक्षमाणोपि यत्नतः..66..
5.268.m: Then Śakra was constantly looking for a pretext against Vṛtra, / but he found no vulnerability anywhere, though watching with effort.

5.268.s:
kathaṃcidapi so'bhyeti tatsakāśaṃ puraṃdaraḥ..
kiṃcicchidraṃ samāsādya tatpratāpena dahyate..67..
5.268.d:
कथंचिदपि सोऽभ्येति तत्सकाशं पुरंदरः..
किंचिच्छिद्रं समासाद्य तत्प्रतापेन दह्यते..67..
5.268.m: Somehow Purandara would approach his presence; / catching a slight opening, he was scorched by his fiery splendor.

5.268.s:
iṃdra uvāca..
na śaknomi ca taṃ daityaṃ vīkṣituṃ ca kathaṃcana..
tejasā sarvato vyāptaṃ tatkathaṃ sūdayāmyaham..68..
5.268.d:
इंद्र उवाच..
न शक्नोमि च तं दैत्यं वीक्षितुं च कथंचन..
तेजसा सर्वतो व्याप्तं तत्कथं सूदयाम्यहम्..68..
5.268.m:
Indra said:
I am not even able to look upon that Daitya; / he is pervaded on all sides by fiery power. How then can I slay him?

5.268.s:
tasmātkaṃcidupāyaṃ me tadvadhārthaṃ prakīrtaya..
yathā śaknomi tatsoḍhuṃ tejastasya durātmanaḥ..69..
5.268.d:
तस्मात्कंचिदुपायं मे तद्वधार्थं प्रकीर्तय..
यथा शक्नोमि तत्सोढुं तेजस्तस्य दुरात्मनः..69..
5.268.m: Therefore, reveal some means for his slaughter to me, / so that I may be able to endure that evil-minded one's fiery splendor.

5.268.s:
sūta uvāca..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ciraṃ dhyātvā bṛhaspatiḥ..
tataḥ provāca taṃ śakraṃ vinayāvanataṃ sthitam..6.269.70..
5.268.d:
सूत उवाच..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा चिरं ध्यात्वा बृहस्पतिः..
ततः प्रोवाच तं शक्रं विनयावनतं स्थितम्..6.269.70..
5.268.m:
Sūta said:
Having heard his speech and meditated for a long time, Bṛhaspati / then addressed Śakra, who stood bowed down in humility:

5.268.s:
bṛhaspatiruvāca..
tasya brāhmyaṃ sthitaṃ tejaḥ samyaggātre puraṃdara..
vīkṣituṃ naiva śaknoṣi tena tvaṃ tridaśādhipa..71..
5.268.d:
बृहस्पतिरुवाच..
तस्य ब्राह्म्यं स्थितं तेजः सम्यग्गात्रे पुरंदर..
वीक्षितुं नैव शक्नोषि तेन त्वं त्रिदशाधिप..71..
5.268.m:
Bṛhaspati said:
Brahmic splendor is fully abiding in his body, O Purandara; / because of that, O lord of the thirty [gods], you cannot even look at him.

5.268.s:
tathā te kīrtayiṣyāmi tasyopāyaṃ vadhodbhavam..
vadhayiṣyasi yenātra taṃ tvaṃ dānavasattamam..72..
5.268.d:
तथा ते कीर्तयिष्यामि तस्योपायं वधोद्भवम्..
वधयिष्यसि येनात्र तं त्वं दानवसत्तमम्..72..
5.268.m: So I will declare to you the means for his slaughter, / by which you will slay that best of Dānavas here.

5.268.s:
prācīsarasvatītīre puṣkarāraṇyamāśritaḥ..
dadhīcirnāma viprarṣiḥ śatayojanamucchritaḥ..73..
tatra nityaṃ tapaḥ kurvanstauti nityaṃ pitāmaham.
sa nirviṇṇo muniśreṣṭhaḥ prāṇānāṃ dhāraṇe hare..74..
5.268.d:
प्राचीसरस्वतीतीरे पुष्करारण्यमाश्रितः..
दधीचिर्नाम विप्रर्षिः शतयोजनमुच्छ्रितः..73..
तत्र नित्यं तपः कुर्वन्स्तौति नित्यं पितामहम्.
स निर्विण्णो मुनिश्रेष्ठः प्राणानां धारणे हरे..74..
5.268.m: Dwelling in the Puṣkara forest on the bank of the eastern Sarasvatī, / is a brahmin seer named Dadhīci, a hundred yojanas tall. / Performing tapas there constantly, he always praises the Grandfather [Brahmā]. / That best of munis has grown weary of clinging to his life, O Hari!

5.268.s:
ciraṃtano muniḥ sa syājjarayātisamāvṛtaḥ..
taṃ prārthaya drutaṃ gatvā tasyāsthīni gurūṇi ca..75..
5.268.d:
चिरंतनो मुनिः स स्याज्जरयातिसमावृतः..
तं प्रार्थय द्रुतं गत्वा तस्यास्थीनि गुरूणि च..75..
5.268.m: He is an ancient muni, heavily covered in old age. / Go quickly and beg him for his massive bones.

5.268.s:
sa te dāsyastyasaṃdigdhaṃ tyaktvā prāṇānatipriyān..
tasyāsthibhiḥ praharaṇaṃ vajrākhyaṃ te bhaviṣyati..76..
5.268.d:
स ते दास्यस्त्यसंदिग्धं त्यक्त्वा प्राणानतिप्रियान्..
तस्यास्थिभिः प्रहरणं वज्राख्यं ते भविष्यति..76..
5.268.m: Without a doubt he will give them to you, casting off his dearest life. / With his bones you will obtain the weapon called Vajra.

5.268.s:
amoghaṃ te tato nūnaṃ tvaṃ vṛtraṃ sūdayiṣyasi..
tasya vajrasya tattejo brahmatejo'bhibṛṃhitam..
tena vṛtrodbhavaṃ tejaḥ praśamaṃ saṃprayāsyati..77..
5.268.d:
अमोघं ते ततो नूनं त्वं वृत्रं सूदयिष्यसि..
तस्य वज्रस्य तत्तेजो ब्रह्मतेजोऽभिबृंहितम्..
तेन वृत्रोद्भवं तेजः प्रशमं संप्रयास्यति..77..
5.268.m: It will be unfailing for you; then you will surely destroy Vṛtra. / That splendor of the Vajra will be augmented by brahmic power; / thereby the fiery splendor born of Vṛtra will be extinguished.

5.268.s:
sūta uvāca..
tacchrutvā satvaraṃ śakraḥ sarvairdaivagaṇaiḥ saha..
jagāma puṣkarāraṇye yatra prācī sarasvatī..78..
5.268.d:
सूत उवाच..
तच्छ्रुत्वा सत्वरं शक्रः सर्वैर्दैवगणैः सह..
जगाम पुष्करारण्ये यत्र प्राची सरस्वती..78..
5.268.m:
Sūta said:
Having heard that, Śakra went swiftly with all the hosts of gods / to the Puṣkara forest where the eastern Sarasvatī flows.

5.268.s:
trayastriṃśatsamopetā tīrthānāṃ koṭibhiryutā..
dadhīcerāśramaṃ tatra so'viśaccitrasaṃyutam..79..
5.268.d:
त्रयस्त्रिंशत्समोपेता तीर्थानां कोटिभिर्युता..
दधीचेराश्रमं तत्र सोऽविशच्चित्रसंयुतम्..79..
5.268.m: Endowed with thirty-three and accompanied by crores of tīrthas, / there he entered Dadhīci's wondrous hermitage.

5.268.s:
krīḍaṃte nakulaiḥ sarpā yatra tuṣṭiṃ gatā mithaḥ..
mṛgāḥ paṃcānanaiḥ sārdhaṃ vṛṣadaṃśāstathā''khubhiḥ..6.269.80..
5.268.d:
क्रीडंते नकुलैः सर्पा यत्र तुष्टिं गता मिथः..
मृगाः पंचाननैः सार्धं वृषदंशास्तथा'ऽखुभिः..6.269.80..
5.268.m: There snakes play with mongooses, mutually content, / deer with lions, and cats with mice.

5.268.s:
ulūka sahitāḥ kākā mitho dveṣavivarjitāḥ..
prabhāvāttasya tapaso dadhīceḥ sumahātmanaḥ..81..
5.268.d:
उलूक सहिताः काका मिथो द्वेषविवर्जिताः..
प्रभावात्तस्य तपसो दधीचेः सुमहात्मनः..81..
5.268.m: Crows together with owls are free from mutual hatred, / by the power of the tapas of that great-souled Dadhīci.

5.268.s:
dadhīcirapi cālokya devāñchakrapurogamān..
samāyātānprahṛṣṭātmā satvaraṃ saṃmukhobhyagāt..82..
5.268.d:
दधीचिरपि चालोक्य देवाञ्छक्रपुरोगमान्..
समायातान्प्रहृष्टात्मा सत्वरं संमुखोभ्यगात्..82..
5.268.m: Seeing the gods arrive headed by Śakra, Dadhīci too / became rejoiced in mind and went forward to meet them quickly.

5.268.s:
tataścārghyaṃ samādāya praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ..
śakramabhyāgataṃ prāha kiṃ te kṛtyaṃ karomyaham..83..
5.268.d:
ततश्चार्घ्यं समादाय प्रणिपत्य मुहुर्मुहुः..
शक्रमभ्यागतं प्राह किं ते कृत्यं करोम्यहम्..83..
5.268.m: Then, taking up water for an offering of honor and bowing repeatedly, / he said to Śakra who had arrived: "What duty shall I perform for you?

5.268.s:
gṛhāyātasya deveśa tacchīghraṃ me nivedaya..84..
iṃdra uvāca..
ātithyaṃ kuru vipreṃdra gṛhāyātasya sanmune..
tvadasthīni nijānyāśu mama dehyavikalpitam..85..
5.268.d:
गृहायातस्य देवेश तच्छीघ्रं मे निवेदय..84..
इंद्र उवाच..
आतिथ्यं कुरु विप्रेंद्र गृहायातस्य सन्मुने..
त्वदस्थीनि निजान्याशु मम देह्यविकल्पितम्..85..
5.268.m: O lord of the gods, declare quickly to me what [can be done] for you who have come to my home." / Indra said: / "Offer hospitality, O best of brahmins, to one who has come to your home, O virtuous muni! / Give your own bones to me quickly without hesitation.

5.268.s:
atadarthamahaṃ prāptastvatsakāśaṃ munīśvara..
asthibhiste paraṃ kāryaṃ devānāṃ siddhimeṣyati..86..
5.268.d:
अतदर्थमहं प्राप्तस्त्वत्सकाशं मुनीश्वर..
अस्थिभिस्ते परं कार्यं देवानां सिद्धिमेष्यति..86..
5.268.m: It is for that purpose that I have come to you, O lord of munis. / Through your bones the supreme purpose of the gods will be accomplished."

5.268.s:
sūta uvāca..
iṃdrasya tadvacaḥ śrutvā dadhīcistoṣasaṃyutaḥ..
tataḥ prāha sahasrākṣaṃ sarvairdevaiḥ samanvitam..87..
5.268.d:
सूत उवाच..
इंद्रस्य तद्वचः श्रुत्वा दधीचिस्तोषसंयुतः..
ततः प्राह सहस्राक्षं सर्वैर्देवैः समन्वितम्..87..
5.268.m:
Sūta said:
Having heard that speech of Indra, Dadhīci was filled with joy. / Then he spoke to the thousand-eyed [Indra] who was accompanied by all the gods:

5.268.s:
aho nāsti mayā tulyaḥ sāṃprataṃ bhuvi kaścana..
puṇyavānyasya deveśaḥ svayamarthī gṛhāgataḥ.88..
5.268.d:
अहो नास्ति मया तुल्यः सांप्रतं भुवि कश्चन..
पुण्यवान्यस्य देवेशः स्वयमर्थी गृहागतः.88..
5.268.m: Ah, there is none equal to me on earth today / in merit, since the lord of gods has himself come to my house as a petitioner!

5.268.s:
dhanyāni ca mamāsthīni yāni deveśa te hitam..
kariṣyaṃti sadā kāryaṃ rakṣārthaṃ tridivaukasām..89..
5.268.d:
धन्यानि च ममास्थीनि यानि देवेश ते हितम्..
करिष्यंति सदा कार्यं रक्षार्थं त्रिदिवौकसाम्..89..
5.268.m: Blessed are my bones, O lord of gods, which will always / perform what is beneficial for you and for the protection of heaven's dwellers.

5.268.s:
eṣo'haṃ saṃpradāsyāmi priyānprāṇānkṛte tava..
gṛhāṇa svecchayā'sthīni svakāryārthaṃ puraṃdara..6.269.90..
5.268.d:
एषोऽहं संप्रदास्यामि प्रियान्प्राणान्कृते तव..
गृहाण स्वेच्छयाऽस्थीनि स्वकार्यार्थं पुरंदर..6.269.90..
5.268.m: Here, I will give up my dear life for your sake. / Take the bones at your will for your own purpose, O Purandara!

5.268.s:
evamuktvā maharṣiḥ sa dhyānamāśritya satvaram..
brahmaraṃdhreṇa niḥsārya prāṇamātmānamatyajat..91..
tadātmanā parityaktaṃ tasya gātraṃ ca tatkṣaṇāt..
patitaṃ medanīpṛṣṭhe vyasu taddvijasattamāḥ.. 91..
5.268.d:
एवमुक्त्वा महर्षिः स ध्यानमाश्रित्य सत्वरम्..
ब्रह्मरंध्रेण निःसार्य प्राणमात्मानमत्यजत्..91..
तदात्मना परित्यक्तं तस्य गात्रं च तत्क्षणात्..
पतितं मेदनीपृष्ठे व्यसु तद्द्विजसत्तमाः.. 91..
5.268.m:
Having spoken thus, that great seer quickly resorted to meditation, / and releasing his life-breath through the brahmarandhra, he abandoned his soul.
His body, abandoned by the self, at that instant / fell lifeless onto the surface of the earth, O best of brahmins!

5.268.s:
tasminneva kāle tu tasyāsthīni śatakratuḥ..
pragṛhya viśvakarmāṇaṃ tataḥ provāca sādaram..93..
5.268.d:
तस्मिन्नेव काले तु तस्यास्थीनि शतक्रतुः..
प्रगृह्य विश्वकर्माणं ततः प्रोवाच सादरम्..93..
5.268.m: At that very time, Śatakratu, taking his bones, / respectfully addressed Viśvakarman:

5.268.s:
etairasthibhiḥ śīghraṃ me kuru tvaṃ vajramāyudham..
yena vyāpādayāmyāśu vṛtraṃ dānavasattamam..94..
5.268.d:
एतैरस्थिभिः शीघ्रं मे कुरु त्वं वज्रमायुधम्..
येन व्यापादयाम्याशु वृत्रं दानवसत्तमम्..94..
5.268.m: With these bones make for me quickly the Vajra weapon, / by which I may soon destroy Vṛtra, the greatest of the Dānavas.

5.268.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā viśvakarmā tvarānvitaḥ..
yathāyudhaṃ tathā cakre vajrākhyaṃ dāruṇākṛti..95..
5.268.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विश्वकर्मा त्वरान्वितः..
यथायुधं तथा चक्रे वज्राख्यं दारुणाकृति..95..
5.268.m: Having heard his word, Viśvakarman in haste / made the weapon named Vajra, of terrifying form.

5.268.s:
ṣaḍasri śataparvākhyaṃ madhye kṣāmaṃ vibhīṣaṇam..
pradadau ca tatastasmai sahasrākṣāya dhīmate..96..
5.268.d:
षडस्रि शतपर्वाख्यं मध्ये क्षामं विभीषणम्..
प्रददौ च ततस्तस्मै सहस्राक्षाय धीमते..96..
5.268.m: Six-sided, called the hundred-jointed, slender in the middle, and formidable, / he gave it then to that wise thousand-eyed [god].

5.268.s:
atha taṃ sa samādāya dvādaśārkasamaprabham..
samādhisthaṃ carairjñātvā vṛtraṃ saṃdhyārcane ratam..97..
5.268.d:
अथ तं स समादाय द्वादशार्कसमप्रभम्..
समाधिस्थं चरैर्ज्ञात्वा वृत्रं संध्यार्चने रतम्..97..
5.268.m: Then, taking it which shone like twelve suns, / having learned from spies that Vṛtra was in meditation, engaged in twilight worship,

5.268.s:
tataśca pṛṣṭhabhāgaṃ sa samāśritya trilokarāṭ..
cikṣepa vajramuddiśya tadvadhārthaṃ samutsukaḥ..98..
5.268.d:
ततश्च पृष्ठभागं स समाश्रित्य त्रिलोकराट्..
चिक्षेप वज्रमुद्दिश्य तद्वधार्थं समुत्सुकः..98..
5.268.m: the king of the three worlds, approaching behind his back, / hurled the Vajra aiming at him, eager for his slaughter.

5.268.s:
sa hatastena vajreṇa dānavo bhasmasādgataḥ..
śakropi hatamajñātvā bhayāttasyātha dudruve..99..
5.268.d:
स हतस्तेन वज्रेण दानवो भस्मसाद्गतः..
शक्रोपि हतमज्ञात्वा भयात्तस्याथ दुद्रुवे..99..
5.268.m: Struck by that Vajra, the Dānava turned to ashes. / But Śakra, not knowing that he was slain, fled in terror.

5.268.s:
manuṣyarahite deśe viṣame gulmasaṃvṛte..
lilye śakrastadā sarvaṃ mene vṛtramayaṃ jagat..6.269.100..
5.268.d:
मनुष्यरहिते देशे विषमे गुल्मसंवृते..
लिल्ये शक्रस्तदा सर्वं मेने वृत्रमयं जगत्..6.269.100..
5.268.m: In a desolate, rugged place overgrown with shrubs, / Śakra hid then, fancying the whole world filled with Vṛtra.

5.268.s:
etasminnaṃtare devāḥ paśyaṃtaḥ sarvato diśam..
siddhacāraṇagandharvā ājagmuśca śatakratum..101..
5.268.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवाः पश्यंतः सर्वतो दिशम्..
सिद्धचारणगन्धर्वा आजग्मुश्च शतक्रतुम्..101..
5.268.m: Meanwhile, the gods, looking in every direction, / together with the Siddhas, Cāraṇas, and Gandharvas, approached Śatakratu.

5.268.s:
tataḥ kṛcchrācca tairdṛṣṭaḥ śakro'sau gahane vane.
nilīno bhayasaṃtrasto gulmamadhye vyavasthitaḥ..102..
5.268.d:
ततः कृच्छ्राच्च तैर्दृष्टः शक्रोऽसौ गहने वने.
निलीनो भयसंत्रस्तो गुल्ममध्ये व्यवस्थितः..102..
5.268.m: Then, with difficulty, they saw Śakra in the dense forest, / hidden, terrified with fear, and settled in the midst of a thicket.

5.268.s:
devā ūcuḥ..
kiṃ tvaṃ bhītaḥ sahasrākṣa vṛtro'yaṃ ghātitastvayā..
parivāreṇa sarveṇa vīkṣito'smābhireva ca..103..
5.268.d:
देवा ऊचुः..
किं त्वं भीतः सहस्राक्ष वृत्रोऽयं घातितस्त्वया..
परिवारेण सर्वेण वीक्षितोऽस्माभिरेव च..103..
5.268.m: The gods said: / 'Why are you afraid, O thousand-eyed one? This Vṛtra has been slain by you; / and he was seen by us together with his entire entourage.

5.268.s:
asmādāgaccha gacchāmo gṛhaṃ prati puraṃdara..
kuru trailokyarājyaṃ tvaṃ sāṃprataṃ hatakaṇṭakam..104..
5.268.d:
अस्मादागच्छ गच्छामो गृहं प्रति पुरंदर..
कुरु त्रैलोक्यराज्यं त्वं सांप्रतं हतकण्टकम्..104..
5.268.m: Come out from here, O Puraṃdara, let us go home; / rule now over the kingdom of the three worlds, its thorns removed!'

5.268.s:
tacchrutvā'tha viniṣkrāṃto gulmamadhyācchatakratuḥ..
hṛṣṭaromā hataṃ śrutvā vṛtraṃ dānavasattamam.. 105..
5.268.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वाऽथ विनिष्क्रांतो गुल्ममध्याच्छतक्रतुः..
हृष्टरोमा हतं श्रुत्वा वृत्रं दानवसत्तमम्.. 105..
5.268.m: Hearing that, Śatakratu then came out from the midst of the thicket, / his hair standing on end with joy upon hearing that Vṛtra, the best of the Dānavas, had been slain.

5.268.s:
atha paśyaṃti yāvattaṃ devāḥ sarve śatakratum..
tāvattejovihīnaṃ tadgātraṃ durgaṃdhitāyutam..106..
5.268.d:
अथ पश्यंति यावत्तं देवाः सर्वे शतक्रतुम्..
तावत्तेजोविहीनं तद्गात्रं दुर्गंधितायुतम्..106..
5.268.m: Now, as soon as all the gods looked upon Śatakratu, / so soon did they see his body bereft of splendor and filled with a foul stench.

5.268.s:
dṛṣṭvā lokagururbrahmā devānsarvānuvāca ha..
śakro'yaṃ sāṃprataṃ vyāptaḥ pāpayā brahmahatyayā..107..
5.268.d:
दृष्ट्वा लोकगुरुर्ब्रह्मा देवान्सर्वानुवाच ह..
शक्रोऽयं सांप्रतं व्याप्तः पापया ब्रह्महत्यया..107..
5.268.m: Seeing [him], Brahmā, the teacher of the world, said to all the gods: / 'Śakra is now overtaken by the evil sin of killing a brahmin.

5.268.s:
yadanena hato vṛtro brahmabhūtaśchalena saḥ..
tasmāttyājyaḥ sudūreṇa no cetpāpamavāpsyatha..108..
5.268.d:
यदनेन हतो वृत्रो ब्रह्मभूतश्छलेन सः..
तस्मात्त्याज्यः सुदूरेण नो चेत्पापमवाप्स्यथ..108..
5.268.m: Because he slew that Vṛtra, who was a brahmin, through trickery; / therefore, he must be avoided from afar, lest you incur sin.

5.268.s:
brahmaghnena samaṃ sparśaḥ saṃbhāṣo'tha vinirmitaḥ..
pāpāya jāyate puṃsāṃ tasmāttaṃ dūratastyajet..109..
5.268.d:
ब्रह्मघ्नेन समं स्पर्शः संभाषोऽथ विनिर्मितः..
पापाय जायते पुंसां तस्मात्तं दूरतस्त्यजेत्..109..
5.268.m: Touch or conversation engaged in with a slayer of a brahmin / results in sin for men; therefore, one should shun him from afar.

5.268.s:
āstāṃ saṃsparśanaṃ tasya saṃbhāṣo vā viśeṣataḥ..
darśanaṃ vāpi tasyāhuḥ sarvapāpapradaṃ nṛṇām..6.269.110..
5.268.d:
आस्तां संस्पर्शनं तस्य संभाषो वा विशेषतः..
दर्शनं वापि तस्याहुः सर्वपापप्रदं नृणाम्..6.269.110..
5.268.m: Let alone touching or especially conversing with him; / they say that even the darśana of him brings all sins upon men.'

5.268.s:
sūta uvāca..
tacchrutvā brahmaṇo vākyaṃ śakro dṛṣṭvā''tmanastanum..
tejasā saṃparityaktāṃ durgandhena samāvṛtām..111..
5.268.d:
सूत उवाच..
तच्छ्रुत्वा ब्रह्मणो वाक्यं शक्रो दृष्ट्वा'ऽत्मनस्तनुम्..
तेजसा संपरित्यक्तां दुर्गन्धेन समावृताम्..111..
5.268.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that speech of Brahmā, Śakra, seeing his own body / abandoned by splendor and pervaded by a foul stench,

5.268.s:
tataḥ provāca lokeśaṃ dīnaḥ praṇatakandharaḥ..
tavāhaṃ kiṃkaro deva tvayeṃdratve niyojitaḥ..112..
5.268.d:
ततः प्रोवाच लोकेशं दीनः प्रणतकन्धरः..
तवाहं किंकरो देव त्वयेंद्रत्वे नियोजितः..112..
5.268.m: then, dejected and with neck bowed low, spoke to the lord of the world: / 'O god, I am your servant, appointed to the status of Indra by you.

5.268.s:
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me brahmahatyāvināśanam..
prāyaścittaṃ vibho brūhi yena śuddhiḥ prajāyate..113.
5.268.d:
तस्मात्कुरु प्रसादं मे ब्रह्महत्याविनाशनम्..
प्रायश्चित्तं विभो ब्रूहि येन शुद्धिः प्रजायते..113.
5.268.m: Therefore, grant me the favor that destroys the sin of killing a brahmin; / O lord, tell me the expiation by which purification may occur.'

5.268.s:
brahmovāca..
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu tīrtheṣu tvaṃ snātvā balasūdana..
ātmānaṃ hemajaṃ dehi pāpapūruṣasaṃjñitam..114..
5.268.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच..
अष्टषष्टिषु तीर्थेषु त्वं स्नात्वा बलसूदन..
आत्मानं हेमजं देहि पापपूरुषसंज्ञितम्..114..
5.268.m: Brahmā said: / 'Having bathed in the sixty-eight sacred fords, O slayer of Bala, / offer [an image of] yourself made of gold, called the "sin-person",

5.268.s:
maṃtravattaṃ yathoktaṃ ca brāhmaṇāya mahātmane..
snātvā puṇyajale tīrthe brahmaghno'hamiti bruvan..115..
5.268.d:
मंत्रवत्तं यथोक्तं च ब्राह्मणाय महात्मने..
स्नात्वा पुण्यजले तीर्थे ब्रह्मघ्नोऽहमिति ब्रुवन्..115..
5.268.m: accompanied by mantras and as prescribed, to a great-souled brahmin, / after bathing in the sacred ford of holy waters and declaring, "I am a slayer of a brahmin."

5.268.s:
snātamātrasya te hastādyatra tatpatati kṣitau..
tejaḥ saṃjāyategātre durgaṃdhaśca praṇaśyati..116..
5.268.d:
स्नातमात्रस्य ते हस्ताद्यत्र तत्पतति क्षितौ..
तेजः संजायतेगात्रे दुर्गंधश्च प्रणश्यति..116..
5.268.m: As soon as you have bathed, wherever that [skull] falls to the earth from your hand, / splendor will arise in your body and the foul stench will perish.

5.268.s:
tasmiṃstīrthe tvayā tacca sthāpyaṃ śakra kapālakam..
maheśvarasya nāmnā ca pūjanīyaṃ tataḥ param..117..
5.268.d:
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे त्वया तच्च स्थाप्यं शक्र कपालकम्..
महेश्वरस्य नाम्ना च पूजनीयं ततः परम्..117..
5.268.m: In that sacred ford, that skull must be established by you, O Śakra; / and thereafter it is to be worshipped in the name of Maheśvara.

5.268.s:
paṃcabhirvaktramaṃtraiśca tato deyā''tmatastanūḥ..
hemodbhavā dvijendrāya tataḥ śuddhimavāpsyasi..118..
5.268.d:
पंचभिर्वक्त्रमंत्रैश्च ततो देया'ऽत्मतस्तनूः..
हेमोद्भवा द्विजेन्द्राय ततः शुद्धिमवाप्स्यसि..118..
5.268.m: And with the five face-mantras, the golden image of your own body / must then be given to the best of brahmins; then you will attain purification.'

5.268.s:
śakrastu tadvacaḥ śrutvā brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ..
kapālaṃ vṛtrajaṃ gṛhya tīrthayātrāṃ tato gataḥ..119..
5.268.d:
शक्रस्तु तद्वचः श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः..
कपालं वृत्रजं गृह्य तीर्थयात्रां ततो गतः..119..
5.268.m: Hearing those words of Brahmā, the unmanifest-born, / Śakra took the skull born of Vṛtra and then went on a pilgrimage to sacred fords.

5.268.s:
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu tīrtheṣu gacchansa ca sureśvaraḥ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre samāyātaḥ krameṇa ca..6.269.120..
5.268.d:
अष्टषष्टिषु तीर्थेषु गच्छन्स च सुरेश्वरः..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे समायातः क्रमेण च..6.269.120..
5.268.m: Going among the sixty-eight sacred fords, that lord of gods / in due course arrived at the sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara.

5.268.s:
viśvāmitrahrade snātvā yāvattasmādvinirgataḥ..
kapālaṃ patitaṃ tasmātsvayameva hatātmanaḥ..121..
5.268.d:
विश्वामित्रह्रदे स्नात्वा यावत्तस्माद्विनिर्गतः..
कपालं पतितं तस्मात्स्वयमेव हतात्मनः..121..
5.268.m: Having bathed in the pool of Viśvāmitra, as soon as he came out from it, / the skull fell of its own accord from the hands of the self-slayer.

5.268.s:
tatastaṃ pūjayāmāsa mantrairvaktrasamudbhavaiḥ..
sarvapāpaharaiḥ puṇyairyathoktairbrahmaṇā purā..122..
5.268.d:
ततस्तं पूजयामास मन्त्रैर्वक्त्रसमुद्भवैः..
सर्वपापहरैः पुण्यैर्यथोक्तैर्ब्रह्मणा पुरा..122..
5.268.m: Then he worshipped it with the mantras arising from the faces, / auspicious and destroying all sins, as spoken formerly by Brahmā.

5.268.s:
etasminneva kāle tu durgandho nāśamāptavān..
taccharīrāddvijaśreṣṭhā mahattejo vyajāyata..123..
5.268.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु दुर्गन्धो नाशमाप्तवान्..
तच्छरीराद्द्विजश्रेष्ठा महत्तेजो व्यजायत..123..
5.268.m: At that very moment, the foul stench came to an end; / from his body, O best of brahmins, a great splendor arose.

5.268.s:
etasminnantare brahmā saha devaiḥ samāgataḥ..
brahmahatyāvimuktaṃ taṃ jñātvā sarvasurādhipam..124..
5.268.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे ब्रह्मा सह देवैः समागतः..
ब्रह्महत्याविमुक्तं तं ज्ञात्वा सर्वसुराधिपम्..124..
5.268.m: In the meantime, Brahmā arrived together with the gods, / knowing that the ruler of all the gods was freed from the sin of killing a brahmin.

5.268.s:
śrībrahmovāca..
brahmahatyākṛto doṣo gataste surasattama..
śeṣapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ svarṇadānaṃ prayaccha bhoḥ.. 125..
5.268.d:
श्रीब्रह्मोवाच..
ब्रह्महत्याकृतो दोषो गतस्ते सुरसत्तम..
शेषपापविशुद्ध्यर्थं स्वर्णदानं प्रयच्छ भोः.. 125..
5.268.m: The auspicious Brahmā said: / 'The guilt caused by the sin of killing a brahmin has left you, O best of the gods; / for the sake of purifying remaining sins, offer a gift of gold, O lord!

5.268.s:
kapālametaddeśe'tra yattvayā paripūjitam..
vṛtrasya paṃcabhirmaṃtrairharavaktrasamudbhavaiḥ.. 126..
5.268.d:
कपालमेतद्देशेऽत्र यत्त्वया परिपूजितम्..
वृत्रस्य पंचभिर्मंत्रैर्हरवक्त्रसमुद्भवैः.. 126..
5.268.m: Since in this place this skull of Vṛtra was worshipped by you / with the five mantras arising from the faces of Hara,

5.268.s:
pradāsyasi tato bhaktyā hemajāmātmanastanum..
vidhinā maṃtrayuktena tava pāpaṃ prayāsyati..
yadyatpūrvakṛtaṃ kṛtsnaṃ pradāya brāhmaṇāya bhoḥ..127..
5.268.d:
प्रदास्यसि ततो भक्त्या हेमजामात्मनस्तनुम्..
विधिना मंत्रयुक्तेन तव पापं प्रयास्यति..
यद्यत्पूर्वकृतं कृत्स्नं प्रदाय ब्राह्मणाय भोः..127..
5.268.m: you shall therefore give with devotion the golden image of your body / according to the ritual rule, endowed with mantra; and by giving it to a brahmin, / whatever former sin you had done in its entirety will go away, O lord!'

5.268.s:
evamuktastataḥ śakro brahmaṇā surasaṃnidhau..
tathetyuktvā tu tatkālaṃ pāpapiṃḍaṃ nijaṃ dadau..128..
5.268.d:
एवमुक्तस्ततः शक्रो ब्रह्मणा सुरसंनिधौ..
तथेत्युक्त्वा तु तत्कालं पापपिंडं निजं ददौ..128..
5.268.m: Thus addressed then by Brahmā in the presence of the gods, / Śakra, saying "So be it," at that moment gave his own sin-effigy,

5.268.s:
kṛtvā hemamayaṃ viprā brāhmaṇāya mahātmane..
gartātīrthasamutthāya vātākhyāyāhitāgnaye..129..
5.268.d:
कृत्वा हेममयं विप्रा ब्राह्मणाय महात्मने..
गर्तातीर्थसमुत्थाय वाताख्यायाहिताग्नये..129..
5.268.m: having fashioned it out of gold, O brahmins, to a great-souled brahmin / who was an agnihotrin, born at Gartātīrtha, named Vāta.

5.268.s:
etasminnaṃtare vipro garhitaḥ so'tha nāgaraiḥ..
dhigdhikpāpa vṛthā vedā ye tvayā pāritāḥ purā..6.269.130..
5.268.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे विप्रो गर्हितः सोऽथ नागरैः..
धिग्धिक्पाप वृथा वेदा ये त्वया पारिताः पुरा..6.269.130..
5.268.m: At that moment, that brahmin was reviled by the Nāgaras: / 'Fie, fie, sinner! In vain are the Vedas that were mastered by you formerly!

5.268.s:
nāsmābhiḥ saha saṃparkaṃ kadācittvaṃ kariṣyasi..
gṛhītaṃ yattvayā dānaṃ pāpapiṃḍasamudbhavam..131..
5.268.d:
नास्माभिः सह संपर्कं कदाचित्त्वं करिष्यसि..
गृहीतं यत्त्वया दानं पापपिंडसमुद्भवम्..131..
5.268.m: You shall never have contact with us, / since you accepted the gift originating from a sin-effigy.'

5.268.s:
tataḥ provāca vipraḥ sa upamanyukulodbhavaḥ..
vivarṇavadano bhūtvā nāmnā khyātaḥ sa vātakaḥ.. 132..
5.268.d:
ततः प्रोवाच विप्रः स उपमन्युकुलोद्भवः..
विवर्णवदनो भूत्वा नाम्ना ख्यातः स वातकः.. 132..
5.268.m: Then that brahmin, born of the lineage of Upamanyu, / his face grown pale, who was renowned by the name Vātaka, said:

5.268.s:
tvayā śakra pradatto me pāpapiṃḍaḥ svako yataḥ..
mayā pratigrahastena dākṣiṇyena kṛtastava..133..
5.268.d:
त्वया शक्र प्रदत्तो मे पापपिंडः स्वको यतः..
मया प्रतिग्रहस्तेन दाक्षिण्येन कृतस्तव..133..
5.268.m: 'O Śakra, because your own sin-effigy was given to me by you, / its acceptance was done by me out of courtesy to you,

5.268.s:
na lobhena suraśreṣṭha paśyataste vigarhitaḥ..
ahaṃ ca brāhmaṇaiḥ sarvairetairnagaravāsibhiḥ.. 134..
5.268.d:
न लोभेन सुरश्रेष्ठ पश्यतस्ते विगर्हितः..
अहं च ब्राह्मणैः सर्वैरेतैर्नगरवासिभिः.. 134..
5.268.m: not out of greed, O best of the gods; before your eyes, / I have been reviled by all these brahmins residing in the town.

5.268.s: tasmānnāhaṃ grahīṣyāmi etaṃ tava pratigraham..135..
5.268.d: तस्मान्नाहं ग्रहीष्यामि एतं तव प्रतिग्रहम्..135..
5.268.m: Therefore, I will not accept this gift of yours.'

5.268.s:
bhūyo'pi tava dāsyāmi na tvaṃ gṛhṇāsi cetpunaḥ.. bra
hmaśāpaṃ pradāsyāmi dāruṇaṃ ca kṣayātmakam..136..
5.268.d:
भूयोऽपि तव दास्यामि न त्वं गृह्णासि चेत्पुनः.. ब्र
ह्मशापं प्रदास्यामि दारुणं च क्षयात्मकम्..136..
5.268.m: 'I shall give it to you again; if you do not accept it once more, / I will give a brahmin's curse, terrible and destructive.'

5.268.s:
iṃdra uvāca..
vedāgaṃpārago vipro yadi kuryātpratigraham..
na sa pāpena lipyeta padmapatramivāṃbhasā..137..
5.268.d:
इंद्र उवाच..
वेदागंपारगो विप्रो यदि कुर्यात्प्रतिग्रहम्..
न स पापेन लिप्येत पद्मपत्रमिवांभसा..137..
5.268.m: Indra said: / 'If a brahmin who has mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas should accept a gift, / he is not stained by sin, like a lotus leaf by water.

5.268.s:
tasmātte pātakaṃ nāsti śṛṇuṣvātra vaco mama..
etaistvaṃ garhite yasmādbrāhmaṇairnagarodbhavaiḥ..138..
5.268.d:
तस्मात्ते पातकं नास्ति शृणुष्वात्र वचो मम..
एतैस्त्वं गर्हिते यस्माद्ब्राह्मणैर्नगरोद्भवैः..138..
5.268.m: Therefore, there is no guilt for you; hear these words of mine: / because you have been reviled by these brahmins born in the town,

5.268.s:
eteṣāṃ sarvakṛtyeṣu pradhānastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi..
eteṣāṃ putrapautrā ye bhaviṣyaṃti tathā tava..139..
5.268.d:
एतेषां सर्वकृत्येषु प्रधानस्त्वं भविष्यसि..
एतेषां पुत्रपौत्रा ये भविष्यंति तथा तव..139..
5.268.m: you shall be the foremost among them in all rites; / their sons and grandsons who will be born, as well as yours,

5.268.s:
te sarve cājñayā teṣāṃ vartayiṣyaṃtyasaṃśayam..
yuṣmadvākyavihīnaṃ yatkṛtyaṃ svalpamapi dvija..6.269.140..
5.268.d:
ते सर्वे चाज्ञया तेषां वर्तयिष्यंत्यसंशयम्..
युष्मद्वाक्यविहीनं यत्कृत्यं स्वल्पमपि द्विज..6.269.140..
5.268.m: they will all undoubtedly act according to their command; / any rite, however small, performed without your word, O brahmin,

5.268.s:
teṣāṃ saṃpatsyate vandhyaṃ yathā bhasmahutaṃ tathā..
kapālamocanaṃ nāma khyātametadbhaviṣyati..141..
5.268.d:
तेषां संपत्स्यते वन्ध्यं यथा भस्महुतं तथा..
कपालमोचनं नाम ख्यातमेतद्भविष्यति..141..
5.268.m: shall turn out to be barren for them, like an oblation offered into ashes; / and this [place] will become famous by the name Kapālamocana.

5.268.s:
ye tu saṃsmṛtya manujāḥ kapālaṃ mama saddvija..
tatra śrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti te narā muktisaṃyutāḥ..
śrāddhapakṣe viśeṣeṇa prayāsyaṃti parāṃgatim..142..
5.268.d:
ये तु संस्मृत्य मनुजाः कपालं मम सद्द्विज..
तत्र श्राद्धं करिष्यंति ते नरा मुक्तिसंयुताः..
श्राद्धपक्षे विशेषेण प्रयास्यंति परांगतिम्..142..
5.268.m: Those men who, having remembered my skull, O good brahmin, / perform a śrāddha there, those men, endowed with liberation, / especially during the śrāddha fortnight, will attain the supreme state.

5.268.s:
sthānabāhyadvijātīnāṃ kule dāraparigraham..
kṛtvā tvadgotrasaṃbhūtā brāhmaṇā matprasādataḥ..143..
5.268.d:
स्थानबाह्यद्विजातीनां कुले दारपरिग्रहम्..
कृत्वा त्वद्गोत्रसंभूता ब्राह्मणा मत्प्रसादतः..143..
5.268.m: Taking a wife in the family of twice-born men living outside this place, / brahmins born of your gotra, by my grace...'

5.268.s:
vyavahāryā bhaviṣyaṃti nagare sarvakarmasu..
evamuktvā sahasrākṣastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ..144..
5.268.d:
व्यवहार्या भविष्यंति नगरे सर्वकर्मसु..
एवमुक्त्वा सहस्राक्षस्ततश्चादर्शनं गतः..144..
5.268.m:
will be qualified for social interaction in all affairs in the city."
Having spoken thus, the thousand-eyed [Indra] then vanished from sight.

5.268.s:
vātopi tena vittena pratigrahakṛtena ca..
cakāra tatra prāsādaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ..145..
5.268.d:
वातोपि तेन वित्तेन प्रतिग्रहकृतेन च..
चकार तत्र प्रासादं देवदेवस्य शूलिनः..145..
5.268.m:
Vāta too, with that wealth obtained through acceptance of gifts,
built there a temple to the god of gods, the trident-bearer.

5.268.s:
tataḥ provāca śakrastānbrāhmaṇānnagarodbhavān..
kapālamocane snātvā yo devaṃ hyarcayiṣyati..146..
5.268.d:
ततः प्रोवाच शक्रस्तान्ब्राह्मणान्नगरोद्भवान्..
कपालमोचने स्नात्वा यो देवं ह्यर्चयिष्यति..146..
5.268.m:
Then Śakra spoke to those brahmins born in the city:
"Whoever bathes at Kapālamocana and worships the god,

5.268.s:
brahmahatyodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ tasya naśyatyasaṃśayam..
mahāpātakayukto vā vipāpmā saṃbhaviṣyati..147..
5.268.d:
ब्रह्महत्योद्भवं पापं तस्य नश्यत्यसंशयम्..
महापातकयुक्तो वा विपाप्मा संभविष्यति..147..
5.268.m:
his sin arising from the murder of a brahmin is destroyed without doubt,
or even if he is burdened with a mortal sin, he will become free of sin."

5.268.s:
sa tatheti pratijñāya brāhmaṇānnagarodbhavān..
tatraiva svāśramaṃ kṛtvā pūjayāmāsa śaṃkaram..148..
5.268.d:
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय ब्राह्मणान्नगरोद्भवान्..
तत्रैव स्वाश्रमं कृत्वा पूजयामास शंकरम्..148..
5.268.m:
Having agreed [saying], "So be it," to the brahmins born in the city,
he made his own hermitage right there and worshipped Śaṃkara.

5.268.s:
tataḥprabhṛti yatkiṃcitteṣāṃ kṛtyaṃ prajāyate..
tadvākyena prakurvaṃti tatra ye nāgaraḥ sthitāḥ..149..
5.268.d:
ततःप्रभृति यत्किंचित्तेषां कृत्यं प्रजायते..
तद्वाक्येन प्रकुर्वंति तत्र ये नागरः स्थिताः..149..
5.268.m:
From then on, whatever duty arises for them,
the Nāgara [brahmins] residing there perform it according to his word.

5.268.s: etasmātkāraṇājjāto madhyago dvitīyastviha..6.269.150..
5.268.d: एतस्मात्कारणाज्जातो मध्यगो द्वितीयस्त्विह..6.269.150..
5.268.m: For this reason, a second mediator arose here.

5.268.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātamākhyānaṃ pāpanāśanam..
kapāleśvaradevasya śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ nṛṇām..151..
5.268.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातमाख्यानं पापनाशनम्..
कपालेश्वरदेवस्य शृण्वतां पठतां नृणाम्..151..
5.268.m:
All this sin-destroying narrative has been told to you,
for the men who listen to or recite [the tale] of the god Kapāleśvara:

5.268.s:
yathā deveśvarasyātra pāpaṃ naṣṭaṃ mahātmanaḥ..
brahmahatyā yathā naṣṭā tasmiṃstīrthe dvijottamāḥ..152..
5.268.d:
यथा देवेश्वरस्यात्र पापं नष्टं महात्मनः..
ब्रह्महत्या यथा नष्टा तस्मिंस्तीर्थे द्विजोत्तमाः..152..
5.268.m:
how the great-souled lord of gods had his sin destroyed here,
[and] how the murder of a brahmin was destroyed at that sacred ford, O best of brahmins!

5.268.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye vātakeśvarakṣetrakapālamocaneśvarotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonasaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ..269..
5.268.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये वातकेश्वरक्षेत्रकपालमोचनेश्वरोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनसप्तत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः..269..
5.268.m: Thus ends the two hundred and sixty-ninth chapter, entitled "Description of the Origin and Māhātmya of Kapālamocaneśvara in the Vātakeśvara Sacred Field," in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the Mahāpurāṇa of Śrī Skanda, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. // 269

5.269.s:
ānarta uvāca..
mūrkhatvādvā pramādādvā kāmādbālasyato'pi vā..
yo naraḥ kurute pāpaṃ prāyaścittaṃ karoti na ..1..
5.269.d:
आनर्त उवाच..
मूर्खत्वाद्वा प्रमादाद्वा कामाद्बालस्यतोऽपि वा..
यो नरः कुरुते पापं प्रायश्चित्तं करोति न ..1..
5.269.m:
Ānarta said:
"Either out of foolishness, negligence, desire, or childishness,
whatever man commits a sin and performs no expiation,

5.269.s:
tasya pāpakṣayakaraṃ puṇyaṃ brūhi dvijottama..
yena muktirbhavetsadyo yadi tuṣṭo'si me prabho..2..
5.269.d:
तस्य पापक्षयकरं पुण्यं ब्रूहि द्विजोत्तम..
येन मुक्तिर्भवेत्सद्यो यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे प्रभो..2..
5.269.m:
tell me, O best of brahmins, of the merit that destroys his sin,
by which immediate liberation may occur, if you are pleased with me, O master!

5.269.s:
lobhamohaparo yo'sau pāpapiṃḍaṃ mahāmune..
pradadāti vidhiṃ brūhi yena yacchāmyahaṃ drutam..3..
5.269.d:
लोभमोहपरो योऽसौ पापपिंडं महामुने..
प्रददाति विधिं ब्रूहि येन यच्छाम्यहं द्रुतम्..3..
5.269.m:
He who is devoted to greed and delusion—O great sage, tell the rite
by which I may quickly bestow the sin-effigy [so that he may be freed]!"

5.269.s:
bhartṛyajña uvāca..
dadyātsvapiṃḍaṃ sauvarṇaṃ paṃcaviṃśatpalātmakam..4..
5.269.d:
भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच..
दद्यात्स्वपिंडं सौवर्णं पंचविंशत्पलात्मकम्..4..
5.269.m:
Bhartṛyajña said:
"One should give an effigy of oneself made of gold, weighing twenty-five palas.

5.269.s:
vidhāyāparapakṣe tu snāpayitvā vidhānataḥ..
maṃḍapādyaṃ ca prākkṛtvā snātvā dhautāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ..5..
5.269.d:
विधायापरपक्षे तु स्नापयित्वा विधानतः..
मंडपाद्यं च प्राक्कृत्वा स्नात्वा धौतांबरः शुचिः..5..
5.269.m:
Having made it during the dark fortnight, and having bathed it in accordance with the rules,
after first constructing a pavilion and the rest, having bathed and wearing clean garments, pure,

5.269.s:
tadā svarūpaṃ pṛthvyādi pūjayetpāpakṛnnaraḥ..
tathā sa mucyate pāpāttatkṛtāddhi na saṃśayaḥ..6..
5.269.d:
तदा स्वरूपं पृथ्व्यादि पूजयेत्पापकृन्नरः..
तथा स मुच्यते पापात्तत्कृताद्धि न संशयः..6..
5.269.m:
then the man who committed the sin should worship [it as] his own form, beginning with the earth [element];
thus he is freed from the sin committed by him, without doubt.

5.269.s:
caturviṃśatitattvāni pṛthivyādīni yāni ca..
teṣāṃ nāmabhistatpiṃḍaṃ pūjayetannarādhipaḥ..7..
5.269.d:
चतुर्विंशतितत्त्वानि पृथिव्यादीनि यानि च..
तेषां नामभिस्तत्पिंडं पूजयेतन्नराधिपः..7..
5.269.m:
The twenty-four principles, beginning with the earth,
by their names the ruler of men should worship that effigy:

5.269.s:
oṃ pṛthivyai namaḥ..
oṃ adbhyo namaḥ..
oṃ tejase namaḥ..
oṃ vāyave namaḥ..
oṃ ākāśāya namaḥ..
oṃ ghrāṇāya namaḥ..
oṃ jihvāyai namaḥ..
oṃ cakṣuṣe namaḥ..
oṃ tvace namaḥ..
oṃ śrotrāya namaḥ..
oṃ gandhāya namaḥ..
oṃ rasāya namaḥ..
oṃ rūpāya namaḥ..
oṃ sparśāya namaḥ..
oṃ śabdāya namaḥ..
oṃ vāce namaḥ..
oṃ pāṇibhyāṃ namaḥ..
oṃ pādābhyāṃ namaḥ..
oṃ pāyave namaḥ..
oṃ upasthāya namaḥ..
oṃ manase namaḥ..
oṃ buddhyai namaḥ..
oṃ cittāya namaḥ..
oṃ ahaṃkārāya namaḥ.
oṃ kṣetrātmane namaḥ..
oṃ paramātmane namaḥ..
dhūpaṃ dhūrasi maṃtreṇa agnirjyotīti dīpakam..
yuvā suvāseti ca tato vāsāṃsi paridhāpayet..8..
5.269.d:
ओं पृथिव्यै नमः..
ओं अद्भ्यो नमः..
ओं तेजसे नमः..
ओं वायवे नमः..
ओं आकाशाय नमः..
ओं घ्राणाय नमः..
ओं जिह्वायै नमः..
ओं चक्षुषे नमः..
ओं त्वचे नमः..
ओं श्रोत्राय नमः..
ओं गन्धाय नमः..
ओं रसाय नमः..
ओं रूपाय नमः..
ओं स्पर्शाय नमः..
ओं शब्दाय नमः..
ओं वाचे नमः..
ओं पाणिभ्यां नमः..
ओं पादाभ्यां नमः..
ओं पायवे नमः..
ओं उपस्थाय नमः..
ओं मनसे नमः..
ओं बुद्ध्यै नमः..
ओं चित्ताय नमः..
ओं अहंकाराय नमः.
ओं क्षेत्रात्मने नमः..
ओं परमात्मने नमः..
धूपं धूरसि मंत्रेण अग्निर्ज्योतीति दीपकम्..
युवा सुवासेति च ततो वासांसि परिधापयेत्..8..
5.269.m: "Oṃ, homage to the earth! / Oṃ, homage to the waters! / Oṃ, homage to the fire! / Oṃ, homage to the wind! / Oṃ, homage to the ether! / Oṃ, homage to the sense of smell! / Oṃ, homage to the tongue! / Oṃ, homage to the eye! / Oṃ, homage to the skin! / Oṃ, homage to the ear! / Oṃ, homage to smell! / Oṃ, homage to taste! / Oṃ, homage to form! / Oṃ, homage to touch! / Oṃ, homage to sound! / Oṃ, homage to speech! / Oṃ, homage to the two hands! / Oṃ, homage to the two feet! / Oṃ, homage to the excretory organ! / Oṃ, homage to the generative organ! / Oṃ, homage to the mind! / Oṃ, homage to the intellect! / Oṃ, homage to the thinking faculty! / Oṃ, homage to egoism! / Oṃ, homage to the self of the field! / Oṃ, homage to the supreme self!" / [He should offer] incense with the mantra 'dhūr asi', a lamp with 'agnir jyotiḥ', / and then drape garments with 'yuvā suvāsāḥ'.

5.269.s:
tato brāhmaṇamānīya vedavedāṃgapāragam..
prakṣālya caraṇau tasya vāsāṃsi paridhāpayet..9..
5.269.d:
ततो ब्राह्मणमानीय वेदवेदांगपारगम्..
प्रक्षाल्य चरणौ तस्य वासांसि परिधापयेत्..9..
5.269.m:
Then, having brought a brahmin who has mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas,
having washed his feet, he should clothe him in garments,

5.269.s: keyūraiḥ kaṃkaṇaiścaiva aṃgulīyakabhūṣaṇaiḥ.. 6.270.10..
5.269.m: and with armlets, bracelets, and ring ornaments,

5.269.s:
bhūṣayitvā tanuṃ tasya tato mūrtiṃ samānayet..
maṃtreṇānena rājeṃdra brāhmaṇāya nivedayet..11..
5.269.d:
भूषयित्वा तनुं तस्य ततो मूर्तिं समानयेत्..
मंत्रेणानेन राजेंद्र ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत्..11..
5.269.m:
having adorned his body, he should then bring the image forward;
with this mantra, O ruler of kings, he should present it to the brahmin:

5.269.s:
eṣa ātmā mayā dattastava hemamayo dvija..
yatkiṃcidvihitaṃ pāpaṃ pūrvaṃ bhūyāttavākhilam..12..
5.269.d:
एष आत्मा मया दत्तस्तव हेममयो द्विज..
यत्किंचिद्विहितं पापं पूर्वं भूयात्तवाखिलम्..12..
5.269.m:
"This golden self is given by me to you, O brahmin;
whatever sin was committed [by me] in the past, may it all become yours!"

5.269.s:
iti dānamaṃtraḥ..
tatastu brāhmaṇo rājanmaṃtrametaṃ samuccaret..13..
5.269.d:
इति दानमंत्रः..
ततस्तु ब्राह्मणो राजन्मंत्रमेतं समुच्चरेत्..13..
5.269.m:
Thus is the donation mantra.
Then, O king, the brahmin should utter this mantra:

5.269.s:
yatkiṃcidvihitaṃ pāpaṃ tvayā pūrvaṃmayā hi tat..
gṛhītaṃ mūrtirūpaṃ tattatastvaṃ pāpavarjitaḥ..
iti pratigrahamaṃtraḥ.. 14..
5.269.d:
यत्किंचिद्विहितं पापं त्वया पूर्वंमया हि तत्..
गृहीतं मूर्तिरूपं तत्ततस्त्वं पापवर्जितः..
इति प्रतिग्रहमंत्रः.. 14..
5.269.m:
"Whatever sin was committed by you in the past, that has indeed been taken
by me in the form of this image; therefore, you are freed from sin."
Thus is the acceptance mantra.

5.269.s:
evaṃ dattvā vidhānena tato vipraṃ visarjayet..
evaṃ kṛte tato rājaṃstasmai dattvātha dakṣiṇām..15..
5.269.d:
एवं दत्त्वा विधानेन ततो विप्रं विसर्जयेत्..
एवं कृते ततो राजंस्तस्मै दत्त्वाथ दक्षिणाम्..15..
5.269.m:
Having given thus according to the rules, he should then dismiss the brahmin.
When this is done, O king, then having given him a priestly gift,

5.269.s:
yathā tuṣṭiṃ samabhyeti tataḥ pāpaṃ nayatyasau..
tasminkṛte mahārāja pratyayastatkṣaṇādbhavet.. 16..
5.269.d:
यथा तुष्टिं समभ्येति ततः पापं नयत्यसौ..
तस्मिन्कृते महाराज प्रत्ययस्तत्क्षणाद्भवेत्.. 16..
5.269.m:
so that he attains satisfaction, he then takes away the sin.
When that is done, O great king, confirmation arises that very moment:

5.269.s:
śarīraṃ laghutāmeti tejovṛddhiśca jāyate..
svapne ca vīkṣate rātrau saṃtuṣṭamanasaḥ sthitān..17..
5.269.d:
शरीरं लघुतामेति तेजोवृद्धिश्च जायते..
स्वप्ने च वीक्षते रात्रौ संतुष्टमनसः स्थितान्..17..
5.269.m:
his body attains lightness, and an increase in splendor is born;
and at night in a dream he sees, standing with contented minds,

5.269.s:
narānstriyaḥ sitairvastraiḥ śvetamālyānulepanaiḥ..
śvetāngovṛṣabhānaśvāṃstīrthāni vividhāni ca..18..
5.269.d:
नरान्स्त्रियः सितैर्वस्त्रैः श्वेतमाल्यानुलेपनैः..
श्वेतान्गोवृषभानश्वांस्तीर्थानि विविधानि च..18..
5.269.m:
men and women dressed in white garments, with white garlands and ointments,
white cows, bulls, horses, and various sacred fords.

5.269.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ pāpapiṃḍasya dāpanam..
śravaṇādapi rājeṃdra yasya pāpaiḥ pramucyate..19..
5.269.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं पापपिंडस्य दापनम्..
श्रवणादपि राजेंद्र यस्य पापैः प्रमुच्यते..19..
5.269.m:
All this has been related to you regarding the gift of the sin-effigy,
merely by hearing which, O ruler of kings, one is freed from sins.

5.269.s:
anyatrāpi mahādānaṃ pāpapiṇḍo harennṛpa..6.270.20.
ekajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ nijakāyena nirmitam..
kapāleśvaradevasya sahasraguṇitaṃ haret..21..
5.269.d:
अन्यत्रापि महादानं पापपिण्डो हरेन्नृप..6.270.20.
एकजन्मकृतं पापं निजकायेन निर्मितम्..
कपालेश्वरदेवस्य सहस्रगुणितं हरेत्..21..
5.269.m:
Elsewhere too, O king, this great gift, the sin-effigy, takes away / the sin committed in a single lifetime and produced by one's own body;
[at the shrine] of the god Kapāleśvara, it takes away a thousandfold.

5.269.s:
pūrvavaccaiva kartavyo vedimaṃḍapayorvidhiḥ..
paraṃ homaḥ prakartavyo gāyatryā kevalaṃ nṛpa..22.
5.269.d:
पूर्ववच्चैव कर्तव्यो वेदिमंडपयोर्विधिः..
परं होमः प्रकर्तव्यो गायत्र्या केवलं नृप..22.
5.269.m:
The procedure for the altar and the pavilion should be performed just as before;
only the fire sacrifice, O king, must be performed with the Gāyatrī alone."

5.269.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye kapāleśvarakṣetramāhātmyaprasaṃgena pāpapiṃḍapradānavidhānavarṇanaṃnāma saptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ..270..
5.269.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कपालेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यप्रसंगेन पापपिंडप्रदानविधानवर्णनंनाम सप्तत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः..270..
5.269.m: Thus ends the two hundred and seventieth chapter, entitled "Description of the Rules for the Gift of the Sin-Effigy in the Context of the Māhātmya of the Kapāleśvara Sacred Field," in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the Mahāpurāṇa of Śrī Skanda, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. // 270
